description: Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. Why this role You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next. High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals. High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product. High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype. Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works. Your mission Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer. What you will do Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope. Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data. Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps. Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start. Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers. Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use. Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years. Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop. How you work You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work. You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises. You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early. You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects. You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product. Who you work with Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership.  What you bring Must have Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions Clear, structured documentation habits Fluent English and German skills Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK Strong plus Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit) Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms SQL and BI fundamentals How we measure success Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter Customer satisfaction with your contribution Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted Your first 90 days Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects. raw.title: Solutions Architect f/m/d
raw.description:
Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure enables hoteliers to customise their tech stack, automate routine work, and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

Why this role

You are the technical voice in front of strategic customers, at a moment when hospitality is being rebuilt around AI. We are launching our own AI agent platform, and we need architects who can show operators what comes next.

  • High trust. You own the technical answer in front of strategic customers and deals.
  • High visibility. Your work shows up in deals, key accounts and customer stories, and it reaches Product.
  • High freedom. You decide how to solve a problem, which tools to use and what to prototype.
  • Fast iteration. We test ideas within days, try new technology early and share what works.

Your mission

Win and grow strategic accounts with technical credibility, and turn what you learn in the field into input for the product. You look at a customer's current architecture and show how an Apaleo-centred setup delivers their goals. You also help them put AI agents to work, deciding what should be an agent, what it costs and how to set it up. Sales and Account Management own the relationship and the commercial terms. You own the technical answer.

What you will do

  • Technical discovery and solution scoping. Lead discovery where a standard demo is not enough. Write clear scopes covering what Apaleo delivers natively, what needs a short-term solution and what is out of scope.
  • Proofs of concept. Build fast, working proofs of concept (quick demos that show technical fit). Agree scope in writing first, and build in a safe test environment, never with live guest data.
  • Agents and automations. Design and build agents and automations for customer use cases, using n8n or Make today and Apaleo's own AI agent platform as it launches. Write code where agents need deterministic steps.
  • Hands-on delivery and short-term solutions. Work alongside the customer, building only where it unblocks a named deal, removes an adoption risk or fills a product gap. Agree an exit plan (an end date, a replacement and a named owner) before you start.
  • Post-sale health checks and expansions. Diagnose gaps against the go-live specification, run proactive checks (for example 90 days after go-live) and scope integrations for expanding customers.
  • Reusable assets. Turn every engagement into a reference architecture, pattern or template that the next twenty customers can use.
  • Thought leadership. Join prospect and customer conversations on how AI will change hospitality over the next two to three years.
  • Product feedback. Test new technology on real customer problems. Share prototypes and field evidence with Product, ending every experiment with a clear decision: adopt, hand over or drop.

How you work

  • You decide the approach, the stack and the order of work.
  • You protect three guardrails: written scope before a proof of concept, an exit plan before a custom build and no commercial promises.
  • You go from idea to prototype in days and show it early.
  • You think in systems and build for reuse, not one-off projects.
  • You share findings openly with Sales, Account Management and Product.

Who you work with

Sales/BD and Account Management (they call you in at defined deal triggers), Customer Success, Product, Security, Partnerships, RevOps and Senior Leadership. 

What you bring

Must have

  • Multiple years in solution architecture, solution engineering or technical consulting in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex software such as ERP or enterprise platforms
  • Strong API skills: REST, authentication, webhooks and events, and data-flow design
  • Hands-on workflow automation (n8n preferred) and practical experience building with LLM agents
  • A systems thinker with real AI curiosity, who uses AI tools day to day
  • Stakeholder management experience and credibility with executives and IT teams
  • Self-direction, an ownership mindset and the discipline to say no to scope that does not advance a deal
  • Curiosity that ends in working prototypes, not just opinions
  • Clear, structured documentation habits
  • Fluent English and German skills
  • Willingness to travel, including regularly to France and the UK

Strong plus

  • Hospitality or travel experience, including hotel operations and PMS concepts (reservations, folios, rate plans, night audit)
  • Experience with another cloud PMS, channel manager or payments integrations
  • Enterprise architecture experience on large, multi-site projects
  • Applied AI or ML background, or experience with MCP and agent platforms
  • SQL and BI fundamentals

How we measure success

  • Architecture engagements and blueprints delivered each quarter
  • Customer satisfaction with your contribution
  • Adoption of recommended apps, integrations and agents
  • Share of engagements served by an existing reusable pattern
  • Revenue impact e.g. deal unblocked, AI adoption, or churn averted

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1 to 30: Learn the platform and ways of working, shadow discovery and proof of concept work, and take over open customer projects.
  • Days 31 to 60: Lead technical discovery on live deals and run your first health check with Account Management.
  • Days 61 to 90: Deliver a proof of concept or short-term solution end to end with an exit plan, and share your first experiment with Product.

 

What We Offer

Culture & Growth

  • A Diverse & International Team: Work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities, bringing unique cultural perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to shape the future of hospitality tech.
  • Growth & Development: As we scale, so do your opportunities. You'll benefit from 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget, and plenty of chances to take on more responsibility. Our evolving career framework ensures you have increasing opportunities to learn new skills, advance your career, and make an impact.
  • Autonomy & Ownership: Great ideas can come from anywhere. We empower you to take responsibility, make decisions, and contribute directly in an environment built on trust, transparency, and collaboration.
  • Shape the Future of Hospitality Tech: Be part of a fast-growing scale-up transforming the hospitality industry. From day one, your work drives real impact and you'll have the freedom to bring your ideas to life.
  • Competitive & Fair Compensation: We believe great work deserves great pay. Our salaries are competitive and guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. We make sure to recognize and reward performance and contribution.

Perks & Lifestyle

  • Flexible & Remote Work Options: We focus on results, not clocking hours. You can work from home, the office or in a hybrid setup, with flexibility to adapt your schedule as long as it makes sense for your role, your team and our business.
  • Free Public Transport: Travel across Germany with ease using our fully covered Deutschland Ticket.
  • Team Connection: Strong connections fuel collaboration. We celebrate and connect through regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties, and other offsite events.
  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy 30 days of vacation to fully disconnect, recharge, and return inspired.
  • Health & Wellbeing: Prioritize your health with access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios, and wellness options through our EGYM Wellpass membership.

description: At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.   As Senior / Expert HR Tech Solution Architect , you will join the People & Organization Digital Transformation team to help shape and transform Flix's global HR technology landscape. Together with FlixTech, you will support the architecture, integration landscape and governance framework across a complex, multi-entity and multi-country organization — ensuring our technology enables Flix's future HR target operating model. The role reports to the Head of Digital Transformation and works closely with the People Enablement Tech stream, FlixTech, IT Security, Data Privacy and HR teams globally. You will help set the technical and architectural direction that the wider team — including our AI & Automation Engineers and HR Tech Business Analysts — builds within. This role is based in Berlin, given the global scope, regular collaboration with colleagues across European, APAC and US time zones is required.   About the Role Work closely with FlixTech, shape Flix's target HR technology architecture across core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting, document management and surrounding enterprise systems — ensuring the architecture enables our HR target operating and service-delivery model by connecting processes, roles, systems and service tiers while balancing global standards with local requirements. Drive global HRIS transformation initiatives, from major platform revamps and redesigns to potential HRIS migrations — evaluating technology options, building business cases, structuring programs through project plans and RAID/risk frameworks, and driving execution through solution design, integrations, testing, cutover, parallel runs and stabilization. Define HR technology integrations and data flows between the HRIS and surrounding enterprise systems — determining what data moves between systems and through which integration patterns, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware and event-driven architectures. Establish and evolve HR technology governance and control frameworks, including system ownership and RACI, security and role-model design, least privilege and segregation of duties, audit trails, change/release governance, internal controls and data privacy aligned with GDPR and audit/IPO-readiness expectations. Act as the bridge between HR functional and technology teams, translating business and process requirements into target-state solutions and executable designs, and driving global HR technology implementation projects from requirements through go-live. About You 6+ years of experience in HR technology transformation, HRIS, solution architecture, enterprise architecture or HRIS delivery, with a degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Technology or a related field. Strong HR domain and Workday expertise, with an understanding of how core HRIS, payroll, time & attendance, talent, recruiting and surrounding enterprise systems work together across a global HR technology landscape. Any Workday certifications would be an advantage. Demonstrable experience driving Workday transformations, including major Workday redesigns, platform revamps and/or migrations end to end. Hands-on enterprise Workday experience across configuration, integration or migration is a strong differentiator. Strong integration and systems architecture knowledge, including REST APIs, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, SFTP, middleware, data flows and event-driven architectures across complex enterprise environments. Experience supporting the design of HR target operating models, HR service-delivery models and technology governance frameworks, including security and role models, segregation of duties, audit trails, internal controls and data privacy in regulated, multi-country environments. Experience with cloud architecture and AI & automation technologies is critical, including areas such as Claude/GenAI deployment, MCPs, n8n and Rovo Agents, alongside strong Jira project-management capabilities. Fluency in English. Certifications in solution/enterprise architecture, project management, agile or automation (e.g. TOGAF, PMP, SAFe, Scrum, Six Sigma, n8n) are a plus. We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. title: Lead AI Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Empower every employee. Flip ist die führende KI-gestützte Employee Experience Platform für Frontline Worker. Wir revolutionieren, wie die Menschen arbeiten, die die Welt am Laufen halten- in Retail, Manufacturing und Logistics. Eine App. Ein Touch. Alles, was sie brauchen. Unsere Mission: Connect every employee to everything they need in one touch. Stellenausschreibung KI-Orchestrierung steht im Zentrum der Zukunft von Flip. Flip Fusion, ein Multi-Agenten-System zur Code-Generierung, bildet das Herzstück unseres neuesten Produkts. Auch das Ask AI Agent Gateway und die Automatisierung durch Flip Flows laufen auf Fähigkeiten, die unsere KI-Engineers entwickeln und pflegen. Als Lead AI Engineer übernimmst du die KI-Disziplin: Du verantwortest das Wie, also Architektur, Standards und technische Ausrichtung, über alle drei Bereiche hinweg, führst und entwickelst ein Team von drei AI-Engineers weiter und bleibst dabei hands-on an den anspruchsvollsten Problemen. Was dich erwartet KI-Architektur verantworten : Definiere eine kohärente KI-Architektur und einheitliche Standards für Flip Fusion, das Ask AI Agent Gateway und Flip Flows, und stimme sie aufeinander ab. Die größte Herausforderung annehmen : Multi-Agenten-Systeme, die für konkrete Anwendungsfälle gebaut sind, aber generisch genug bleiben, um unterschiedliche Kund:innen zu bedienen, immer im Spannungsfeld zwischen hohen Ansprüchen, Machbarkeit, Zuverlässigkeit und Kosteneffizienz. Die Disziplin führen und weiterentwickeln : Übernimm die disziplinarische Führung für drei KI-Engineers und hilf ihnen dabei, sich zu Engineers zu entwickeln, die den technischen Maßstab selbst setzen. Hands-on bleiben : Rund 70 Prozent deiner Zeit verbringst du im Code, an den Problemen, bei denen dein Urteilsvermögen am meisten zählt. Der Rest entfällt auf technische und disziplinarische Führung. Produktübergreifend Einfluss nehmen : Setze Architekturentscheidungen mit den Product Managern und Engineering Leads um, die die Roadmaps verantworten, die nicht in deinem Bereich liegen, und überzeuge dabei durch das bessere Argument statt durch Weisung. Mit unserem Stack arbeiten : Python, pydantic-ai für Orchestrierung, Qdrant für Vektorsuche, Azure AI für Modelle, deployed auf Kubernetes in ein überwiegend JVM-basiertes (Kotlin, Micronaut) und Go-Backend. Eine junge Disziplin mitgestalten : KI-Engineering ist bei Flip so neu, dass es enormen Gestaltungsspielraum gibt und noch kein festes Playbook existiert. Was du mitbringst Wir suchen einen Engineer mit einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament und echter Praxiserfahrung mit agentenbasierten Systemen in Produktion, der eine Disziplin führen möchte, statt nur an einer Codebase zu arbeiten. Wenn dich die Rolle reizt, du aber nicht jeden Punkt erfüllst, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung. Must-haves: 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit einer nachgewiesenen Erfolgsbilanz auf Senior- oder Staff-Level, aufbauend auf einem soliden Software-Engineering-Fundament (Backend, Platform oder Full-Stack). Praxiserfahrung im Design, Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver LLM-basierter Systeme: RAG, Tool Calling und MCP, Orchestrierung und Evals. Keine Prototypen, sondern Systeme, mit denen du auch nach dem Go-live gelebt hast. Erfahrung mit Multi-Agenten-Orchestrierung, die besonders stark gewichtet wird. Das ist der Kern dessen, was du architektonisch verantworten würdest. Nachgewiesene technische Führungserfahrung: Architekturverantwortung, Tech-Lead-Verantwortung, RFCs, Design Reviews oder das Setzen von Standards für ein Team. Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, technische Arbeit voranzubringen, die nicht in deinem eigenen Verantwortungsbereich liegt: Du gewinnst Architekturdiskussionen durch Überzeugungskraft und Glaubwürdigkeit und bist es gewohnt, recht zu haben, ohne die Entscheidungsgewalt zu haben. Nachweise dafür, dass du Menschen weiterentwickelst: Coaching oder Mentoring von Engineers hin zu stärkeren Engineers, statt ihnen die Arbeit abzunehmen. Ein klares, ausdrückliches Bekenntnis zu disziplinarischer Führung. Diese Rolle umfasst die Führung von drei Engineers, und das ist nicht der Teil, den du nur in Kauf nimmst, um den technischen Scope zu bekommen. Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und verhandlungssicheres Englisch (C1). Nice-to-haves: Formale Erfahrung in der Personalführung: disziplinarische Führung, Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche, Recruiting. Starke Mentoring-Erfahrung zählt genauso viel. Erfahrung in der teamübergreifenden Führung einer Disziplin oder eines Fachbereichs in einer Matrixorganisation. Produkterfahrung im großen Maßstab: Frontline / Deskless Worker, High-Volume-B2B-SaaS oder Vergleichbares. Erfahrung im Kosten-, Latenz- und Zuverlässigkeits-Engineering für LLM-Systeme: Guardrails, Fallbacks, Evaluation Harnesses. Deutschkenntnisse auf beliebigem Niveau. In Teilen des Unternehmens hilfreich, für diese Rolle aber nie Voraussetzung. Was wir dir bieten Work-Mode : Wir sind remote-first und geben dir damit die Flexibilität, von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Gleichzeitig schätzen wir den Mehrwert der persönlichen Zusammenarbeit sehr. Je nach Rolle nimmst du gelegentlich an Team-Events, Workshops oder Meetings in unseren Büros in Berlin oder Stuttgart teil – selbstverständlich immer mit ausreichend Vorlauf. Das genaue Verhältnis besprechen wir transparent während deines Bewerbungsprozesses. Work-Life-Balance : Wir wollen nicht, dass du an deinem Schreibtischstuhl festwächst und übernehmen deshalb die Kosten für deine E-Gym-Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft und bieten Job-Rad Leasing an. Erfolge feiern : Dich erwarten hoch motivierte und engagierte Menschen in einer lockeren Arbeitsatmosphäre. Mittendrin statt nur dabei : Du gestaltest Flip aktiv mit. Ganz nebenbei bist du Enabler des rasanten Wachstumsprozesses eines jungen Tech-Unternehmens und wächst an deinen Zielen. Gute Laune garantiert. Happy to be a Flipster : Freu dich auf regelmäßige Teamevents und Culture Days, die uns als Flipster zusammenschweißen. Arbeiten im Ausland : Bei Flip kannst du auch im europäischen Ausland arbeiten, lass uns im Interview über Workation sprechen. Damit unsere Stellenanzeigen leichter lesbar sind, verwenden wird im Textverlauf die männliche Form der Anrede. Bei Flip sind alle willkommen ganz egal, welches Geschlecht du hast oder wie alt du bist. Sexuelle Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung und Behinderungen spielen keine Rolle. Das Wichtigste ist, dass DU zu uns passt! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Du bist ein echtes Allround-Talent und scheust dich nicht, in einem vielseitigen Bereich unterschiedlichste Aufgaben zu übernehmen.   • Du übernimmst die strategische Beratung unserer Automotive-Kunden, analysierst ihre geschäftlichen Herausforderungen und entwickelst daraus klare Prioritäten, Handlungsempfehlungen und tragfähige digitale Lösungen.

  • Du verantwortest Workshops, Pitches, Angebote und Roadmaps, berätst Entscheiderinnen und Entscheider auf Augenhöhe und trägst mit deinem Netzwerk und deinen Ideen dazu bei, unser Automotive-Geschäft bei diva-e weiter auszubauen.


Anforderungen

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Beratung anspruchsvoller Kunden, kannst komplexe Themen strukturieren und übernimmst Verantwortung für strategische Entscheidungen und Projektergebnisse.
  • Du verstehst das Zusammenspiel von Business, Customer Experience, Daten, AI und Technologie und kannst AI Use Cases identifizieren, priorisieren und in verantwortungsvoll nutzbare Lösungen mit echtem Mehrwert für Kunden und Nutzer übersetzen.

Are you ready to change the market?

PAIR Finance is reimagining debt collection: We've developed the most advanced AI technology in receivables management, fundamentally transforming the entire collections industry. Today, with over 260 employees, 600+ clients, and 10+ European entities, we're leading the way in AI-powered receivables management - delivering higher recovery rates while protecting our clients customer relationships.

You're responsible for the quality of our collection processes and teams. You develop trainings and document processes that enable your colleagues to deliver consistently high-quality work. Based on sample insights, you analyze gaps, identify improvement opportunities, and directly translate these into optimized trainings and processes. You're the bridge between operations and quality assurance - with a focus on measurable results and continuous improvement.

You work internationally with teams across different markets, expanding our documentation and training materials to new European markets.

Ready to join us? We'd love to see your application!


Your Responsibilities:

  • Training Design, Delivery & Quality Improvement: You develop, implement, and optimize trainings and learning paths. Through regular sample analyses conducted by the team, you identify gaps and directly translate improvements into new trainings
  • Process documentation & expansion: You document, update, and expand our process documentation to additional European markets (such as the UK)
  • Knowledge management: You build and structure a knowledge database that serves as a foundation for AI-powered tools and support the quality management department in AI-driven processes
  • Data-driven optimization: You leverage our KPI reporting for continuous improvement of our quality standards
  • International collaboration: You work cross-functionally with teams across other entities and squads to anchor processes and documentation locally


What we're looking for:

Must-Haves

  • Experience: Minimum 3+ years at senior level in Training & Documentation and/or Quality Management
  • Languages: Fluent in English, German knowledge is beneficial 
  • Technical competence: Experience with Learning Management Systems or learning path design; familiarity with process documentation and process optimization
  • Industry knowledge: Strong understanding of internationally varying regulatory requirements, ideally in Collections and/or Data Protection
  • AI tools: Basic understanding of AI-powered tools such as Claude and their practical application
  • Soft skills: Independent, structured work style with ownership mentality and strong written and verbal communication skills
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience in the collections industry or other heavily regulated sectors (Legal, Finance, Compliance)
  • Knowledge of another European language
  • Experience with Debt Collection in the UK and applicable regulatory requirements
  • Familiarity with SharePoint and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem
  • Experience with Instructional Design (ID) Frameworks, Content Management, or Knowledge Engineering

Our Values
At PAIR Finance, customer-centricity, transparency, and integrity are at the heart of everything we do - and every team member lives these values. We're also driven by innovation and the ambition to actively shape what we do. Do you see yourself reflected in these values? We'd love to meet you!


Our offer for you:

Work Environment

  • Hybrid work model with 2-3 days on-site per week at our modern office in Berlin-Charlottenburg
  • You'll work alongside professional colleagues and experts from over 30 nationalities
  • Your colleagues will support you from day one with advice and practical help, ensuring a warm welcome
  • Transparent feedback & annual development conversations, monthly all-hands meetings, and flat hierarchies
Benefits
  • Permanent employment contract, flexible working hours, and 28 vacation days
  • For this senior position, our salary band is €47,000 - €57,000 per year (based on a 40-hour week). The exact offer depends on your experience and qualifications. We're also open to strong mid-level candidates - in that case, the salary would be below this range
  • Subsidy for Germany ticket plus access to corporate benefits
  • Annual summer and winter parties in Berlin, plus regular team events
Career & Development
  • Challenging, diverse tasks that fuel your steep learning curve
  • Individual training budget and language courses


Our Interview Process:

  • First online interview with Jasmin (Talent Acquisition Specialist): 30-45 minutes
    We get to know you, your motivation and background, and you'll get first insights into PAIR Finance and the role.
  • Second online interview with Sandra (Team Lead Quality Collection): 60 minutes
    We'll dive deeper into your experience and the position. This is your chance to learn more about the tasks, challenges, and the team.
  • Third on-site interview with the entire team: 60 minutes
    We'll conduct a case study during this conversation. Please plan for approximately 1–2 hours of preparation time. We'll assess your functional knowledge, discuss collaboration with internal stakeholders and within the team.


Who is your contact person?

Your point of contact for this position is Jasmin Baldrich. If you have any questions, feel free to send us an email at

description: Über Greenflash Wir arbeiten für etwas, das größer ist als wir selbst. Wir gestalten die Energieversorgung der Industrie von morgen. Das erfordert Menschen mit Ambitionen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und einen spürbaren Beitrag leisten wollen. Wir vertrauen Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen. Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Initiative und Ergebnisse. Deshalb geben wir Menschen früh Verantwortung und den Freiraum, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben. Wir wachsen gemeinsam. Große Ziele entstehen nicht durch Routine. Sie entstehen durch Lernen, Feedback und den Mut, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Genau dafür schaffen wir das passende Umfeld. Deine Mission Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen. Technische Beratung: Du berätst Entwicklungsteams und Fachbereiche bei technischen Fragestellungen, bewertest unterschiedliche Ansätze und findest pragmatische Lösungen. Energie & Software verbinden: Du bringst dein Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung und Energiewirtschaft zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte. Architektur in die Umsetzung bringen: Du begleitest die Entwicklung von der technischen Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen auch im Produkt ankommen. Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter. Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit. Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen Du kennst unsere Systemlandschaft und Architektur. Du übernimmst erste eigene Architekturthemen. Du bringst dich als Sparringspartner in die Entwicklung ein. Du triffst erste Architekturentscheidungen und setzt Impulse. Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelandschaft aktiv mit. Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit. Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger. Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln. Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen. Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung. Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum. Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading. Warum Greenflash Arbeite an etwas, das zählt. Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen. Mehr Verantwortung. Früher. Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Wachstum durch Herausforderungen. Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen. Leistung, die sichtbar wird Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen über sich hinauswachsen können und stolz auf das sind, was sie erreichen. Ein Team mit Ambition Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. Dafür mit viel Vertrauen, Respekt und dem gemeinsamen Anspruch, jeden Tag besser zu werden. Teil einer außergewöhnlichen Reise Greenflash ist nicht einfach ein Arbeitgeber. Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit dem Anspruch, eine ganze Branche mitzugestalten. Wer heute bei Greenflash startet, wird Teil einer Entwicklung, die gerade erst begonnen hat. Erfolge gemeinsam erleben Wir arbeiten mit hohen Ansprüchen. An unsere Arbeit. An unsere Ergebnisse. An uns selbst. Genauso wichtig ist, dass wir Erfolge gemeinsam feiern. Ob bei Team-Events, auf dem Padel-Court oder im Alltag – wir glauben daran, dass starke Leistung und starke Teams zusammengehören. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Initiative und Ergebnisse. Deshalb geben wir Menschen früh Verantwortung und den Freiraum, Themen eigenständig voranzutreiben.

Wir wachsen gemeinsam.
Große Ziele entstehen nicht durch Routine. Sie entstehen durch Lernen, Feedback und den Mut, neue Herausforderungen anzunehmen. Genau dafür schaffen wir das passende Umfeld.


Deine Mission

  • Softwarearchitektur gestalten: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die technische Architektur unserer Software und triffst gemeinsam mit dem Team fundierte Architekturentscheidungen.
  • Technische Beratung: Du berätst Entwicklungsteams und Fachbereiche bei technischen Fragestellungen, bewertest unterschiedliche Ansätze und findest pragmatische Lösungen.
  • Energie & Software verbinden: Du bringst dein Verständnis für Softwareentwicklung und Energiewirtschaft zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in tragfähige technische Konzepte.
  • Architektur in die Umsetzung bringen: Du begleitest die Entwicklung von der technischen Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass Architekturentscheidungen auch im Produkt ankommen.
  • Sparring & Standards: Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Entwickler, schaffst Orientierung bei komplexen Fragestellungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team technische Standards weiter.
  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst Verantwortung für einen Teilbereich unserer EVU-Entwicklung und bringst deine Erfahrung ein, um unsere Software und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern.
  • Mit aufbauen: Du hast Gestaltungsspielraum und wirkst am Aufbau unseres Bereichs für Energieversorger aktiv mit.


Deine Ziele in den ersten 90 Tagen

  • Du kennst unsere Systemlandschaft und Architektur.
  • Du übernimmst erste eigene Architekturthemen.
  • Du bringst dich als Sparringspartner in die Entwicklung ein.
  • Du triffst erste Architekturentscheidungen und setzt Impulse.
  • Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Softwarelandschaft aktiv mit.


Was dir zum Erfolg verhilft

  • Erfahrung: Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung und idealerweise bereits Erfahrung als Software Architect, Technical Lead oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit.
  • Energiewirtschaft: Du kennst die Energiewirtschaft und verstehst die fachlichen Zusammenhänge rund um Energieversorger.
  • Architekturverständnis: Du kannst komplexe technische Zusammenhänge erfassen, Architekturentscheidungen fundiert treffen und diese verständlich vermitteln.
  • Beratungsstärke: Du arbeitest gerne als technischer Sparringspartner, stellst die richtigen Fragen und kannst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenbringen.
  • Innovations- & Optimierungsdrang: Du hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und bringst neue Ideen in die Umsetzung.
  • Eigenverantwortung: Du arbeitest strukturiert, triffst Entscheidungen und bewegst dich sicher in einem Umfeld mit hohem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Nice-to-have: Erfahrung mit Produktverantwortung sowie Python, Airflow, Pandas, Energieflussprognosen oder Energieeinkauf und Intraday-Trading.


Warum Greenflash

  • Arbeite an etwas, das zählt.
    Die Energiewende gehört zu den größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit. Bei Greenflash arbeitest du nicht an irgendeinem Projekt, sondern an Lösungen, die Unternehmen nachhaltiger, unabhängiger und zukunftsfähiger machen. Dein Beitrag wird sichtbar: in Projekten, bei Kunden und in den Ergebnissen, die wir gemeinsam erreichen.
  • Mehr Verantwortung. Früher.
    Wer Initiative zeigt und etwas bewegen möchte, bekommt die Chance dazu. Entscheidungen treffen die Menschen, die nah am Thema sind. So entstehen Geschwindigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. 
  • Wachstum durch Herausforderungen.
    Persönliche Entwicklung beginnt dort, wo die Komfortzone endet. Deshalb setzen wir auf spannende Aufgaben, ehrliches Feedback und Verantwortung statt auf standardisierte Karriereprogramme. Ergänzt wird das durch unsere Greenflash Academy und den täglichen Austausch mit Menschen, die ihr Wissen gerne teilen.
  • Leistung, die sichtbar wird
    Bei Greenflash zählen Ideen, Ergebnisse und der Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Erfolg. Gute Leistung schafft Vertrauen. Vertrauen schafft Verantwortung. Und Verantwortung schafft Entwicklung.     Wir arbeiten an großen Zielen und glauben daran, dass außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse durch außergewöhnliche Teams entstehen. Deshalb setzen wir auf Offenheit, direkte Zusammenarbeit und Menschen, die füreinander einstehen. Ohne Politik. Ohne Silodenken. title: Creative Director Digital (on site - Hamburg)
description: OKTOPODS turns brand clarity into connected experiences that drive measurable growth. OKTOPODS is a brand-led transformation partner for companies whose brand, marketing and digital experience need to work as one. Our three hearts—OKTObrand, OKTOtech and OKTOcreative—connect brand strategy, digital experiences and creative communication. We’re looking for a Creative Director with strong ideas, sharp narrative thinking, excellent craft and the ability to lead people. You’ll lead a focused creative team, combining human creativity and judgment with the speed and possibilities of AI. You’ll own creative direction and quality, guide the narrative, and help the team turn business challenges into compelling solutions. You stay actively involved in concepts, storytelling and design. You also know how to use available AI tools and internal systems to explore ideas, visualise directions, prototype experiences and accelerate execution. Throughout that process, you keep the work strategically clear, coherent and distinctive. You’ll lead creative pitches, advise clients and share responsibility for growth and successful delivery. Aufgaben Develop strong creative ideas. Translate brand positioning, business objectives and client briefs into distinctive concepts, narratives, campaigns and digital experiences. Own the narrative and creative direction. Define what the work should communicate, how it should feel and what it should achieve. Carry that direction consistently from the first idea to final delivery. Stay close to the craft. Contribute directly to key concepts, presentations, storytelling and design decisions, helping the team strengthen and finish the work. Use AI confidently throughout the creative process. Work with existing online tools and internal systems for research, exploration, visualisation, prototyping and production. Choose the right approach for the task. Guide and refine AI output. Provide clear briefs, context and references; judge the results; and steer iterations toward the intended solution. Combine generated material with human refinement to meet the creative standard. Lead and develop a team of three. Establish clear ownership, give useful feedback and coach people. Help the team combine creative skill, practical AI use and efficient collaboration. Set and uphold quality standards. Lead creative reviews and take responsibility for the relevance, originality, consistency and execution of the work. Connect brand, experience and communication. Collaborate across strategy, design, content and technology so the brand promise carries through every touchpoint. Lead creative pitches and client conversations. Develop persuasive recommendations, present ideas clearly, handle feedback and build confidence in the work. Share responsibility for growth and delivery. Develop relevant client opportunities with client service, agree realistic scope and timing with project leads, and make informed decisions about effort, budget and quality. Make our work visible. description: <h2><strong>Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)</strong></h2> <h2><strong>The opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly <strong>3,000 people</strong> work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.</p> <p>More than <strong>500,000 healthcare professionals</strong> use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately <strong>90 million people</strong> across Europe.</p> <p>For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an <strong>AI-powered Health Companion</strong> that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.</p> <p>This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.</p> <p>We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.</p> <h2><strong>What you will build and lead</strong></h2> <p>As <strong>Product Design Director, Patient</strong>, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:</p> <ul> <li>access to care, search and booking;</li> <li>patient messaging and teleconsultation;</li> <li>the Patient Health Record and patient context;</li> <li>the app homepage and daily health experience;</li> <li>health content and prevention;</li> <li>recommendations, reminders and care plans;</li> <li>new patient services and subscription experiences;</li> <li>conversational and AI-powered experiences.</li> </ul> <p>The current team includes <strong>six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer</strong>. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.</p> <h2><strong>Your mandate</strong></h2> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.</li> <li>Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.</li> <li>Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.</li> <li>Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.</li> <li>Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.</li> <li>Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.</li> <li>Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.</li> <li>Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.</li> <li>Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.</li> <li>Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>In your first year, you will have:</p> <ul> <li>established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;</li> <li>raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;</li> <li>helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;</li> <li>strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;</li> <li>developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;</li> <li>helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for</strong></h2> <p>You are likely to bring:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..</li> <li>Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.</li> <li>A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.</li> <li>Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.</li> <li>Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.</li> <li>Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.</li> <li>A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.</li> <li>Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.</li> <li>The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.</li> <li>A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.</li> <li>Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.</li> <li>Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.</li> <li>A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Doctolib, why now?</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.</p> <p>The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.</p> <p>You will join at a defining moment:</p> <ul> <li>Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.</li> <li>AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.</li> <li>The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.</li> <li>The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.</li> <li>The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.</li> </ul> <p>This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of <strong>consumer product design, healthcare and AI</strong>, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. description: <p>Wir suchen Dich als <strong>Pricing &amp; Packaging Senior Lead (x/f/m) </strong>für unser Revenue Operations Team in <strong>Berlin</strong>.</p> <p>Doctolib bietet Arztpraxen in Deutschland ein Portfolio, das von Terminmanagement und Patientenkommunikation über KI-Assistenten für Telefon und Dokumentation bis zur vollständigen Praxissoftware reicht, vertrieben über Field Sales, Inside Sales, Customer Success und Partner. Du verantwortest die Preis- und Paketarchitektur dieses Portfolios: wie wir Preise differenzieren, was ein Einstiegspaket leisten muss, wie unsere Bundles aufgebaut sind und nach welcher Logik wir abrechnen.</p> <p>Die Rolle verbindet Strategie und Umsetzung. Du entwickelst Preisentscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlungsbereitschaft, Wettbewerb und Unit Economics, vertrittst sie gegenüber dem Leadership und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Markt so ankommen, wie sie gedacht sind: im Angebot der Seller:innen, in den Rabattregeln und im realisierten Preis.</p> <p>Nach sechs Monaten hast Du unsere Paketarchitektur auf den Prüfstand gestellt und die nächsten Schritte mit dem Leadership entschieden, eine erste Preis- oder Paketänderung umgesetzt und eine belastbare Sicht darauf aufgebaut, welcher Preis nach Rabatten tatsächlich realisiert wird.</p> <h2><strong>Deine Aufgaben</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Paketarchitektur:</strong> Du entwickelst unsere Paketstruktur vom Einstiegspaket bis zum Komplettangebot weiter und legst fest, welche Produkte und Leistungen wo liegen, wie sich die Stufen voneinander abgrenzen und welche Zusatzoptionen sie ergänzen</li> <li><strong>Preislogik und Differenzierung: </strong>Du definierst, worauf sich ein Preis bezieht, etwa pro Behandler:in, pro Praxis oder nach Nutzung, und wie wir nach Fachrichtung, Praxisgröße oder Vertragslaufzeit differenzieren</li> <li><strong>Evidenz und Business Cases:</strong> Du misst Zahlungsbereitschaft, analysierst Preiselastizität, Conversion und Churn nach Segment, beobachtest den Wettbewerb und rechnest mit Finance die Umsatz- und Margenwirkung jeder Option durch</li> <li><strong>Preisänderungen im Markt:</strong> Du planst Preisanpassungen und Paketwechsel für Neu- und Bestandskund:innen, inklusive Migrationslogik und Kommunikation, und begleitest sie bis in alle Sales Motions</li> <li><strong>Rabatt-Governance und Deal Desk:</strong> Du verantwortest Rabattregeln, Freigabelogik und Sonderkonditionen und machst transparent, wie viel vom Listenpreis tatsächlich realisiert wird</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Dein Profil</strong></h2> <p><em>Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!</em></p> <h3><strong>Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Du hast mehrere Jahre Pricing und Packaging in B2B-SaaS oder einem anderen Subscription-Geschäft gestaltet, im Unternehmen oder in der Pricing-Beratung, und Preis- oder Paketänderungen bis in den Markt gebracht</li> <li>Du weißt, wie man Zahlungsbereitschaft herausfindet, aus Kundengesprächen, Umfragen, Preistests im Markt und Daten zu Abschlüssen, Nutzung und Churn, und baust Deine Preis- und Margenmodelle selbst, in Spreadsheets und SQL</li> <li>Du übersetzt Analysen in klare Empfehlungen zu Preismetrik, Paketgrenzen und Preisniveau und vertrittst sie vor Senior Leadership und Sales Leadership</li> <li>Du setzt KI routiniert in Analyse und Arbeitsabläufen ein, z.B. für Wettbewerbs-Monitoring oder die Auswertung von Deal-Anfragen</li> <li>Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und fließend Englisch</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, mit Health-Tech oder in einem anderen regulierten Markt</li> <li>Erfahrung mit nutzungsbasierten Preismodellen, Self-Service-Buchung oder Testphasen</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Rabatt-Governance, einem Deal Desk oder CPQ-Systemen</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Was wir Dir bieten</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest</li> <li>28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)</li> <li>Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten</li> <li>Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)</li> <li>Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)</li> <li>Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth</li> <li>Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält</li> <li>Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner</li> <li>Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine</li> <li>Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club</li> <li>Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Der Interviewprozess</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Interview mit Deiner TA Partnerin</li> <li>Interview mit Deiner Manager</li> <li>Peer Interview</li> <li>Case Study Interview</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Job Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Festanstellung</li> <li>Vollzeit</li> <li>Arbeitsort: Berlin</li> <li>Hybride Arbeitsweise (3 Tage Office/Woche)</li> <li>Startdatum: ab sofort</li> </ul> <p><em>Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.</em></p> <p><em>Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. description: <p><strong><em>OUR MISSION</em></strong></p> <p><strong>At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.</strong></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong></p> <p>Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.</p> <p><strong><em>CORE VALUES</em></strong></p> <p>One Team. One Redwood</p> <p>Make Your Own Weather</p> <p>Obsess over Customer Success</p> <p>Work the Problem</p> <p>Be Curious</p> <p>Own the Outcome</p> <p>Respect Each Other</p> <p><strong><em>YOUR IMPACT</em></strong></p> <p>Gartner predicts that by 2029, 90% of organizations currently delivering workload automation will have transitioned to Service Orchestration and Automation Platforms (SOAPs) — a market expected to reach $4.9 billion by 2028. Redwood is the top-ranked vendor in Gartner's 2025 Critical Capabilities for SOAP, scoring #1 across all five use cases. We're expanding our Solutions Engineering team to meet that demand. In this role, you'll be the technical face of a category leader — helping enterprise prospects understand not just what Redwood does, but why it's the right answer in a market that's fundamentally changing.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cover the full SOAP surface area.</strong> Present and position Redwood's capabilities across all five Gartner-defined SOAP use cases — IT workload automation, IT workflow orchestration, data orchestration, citizen/self-service automation, and DevOps automation. You won't be a deep expert in all five on day one, but you'll develop enough fluency to lead discovery and qualify the right fit for each prospect.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrate Redwood's platform with AI fluency.</strong> Deliver compelling technical presentations and live product overviews that connect Redwood's AI capabilities — AI-powered observability, intelligent job scheduling, and agentic orchestration — to concrete operational outcomes, not just platform features.</li> <li><strong>Use AI tools as a force multiplier.</strong> Leverage LLM-based research, prompt-driven workflows, and AI productivity tooling as a standard part of how you work — accelerating demo preparation, account research, competitive analysis, and technical documentation.</li> <li><strong>Position confidently in a competitive market.</strong> Develop a working understanding of the SOAP competitive landscape well enough to articulate Redwood's differentiation, handle objections live, and understand why you win and why you lose.</li> <li><strong>Drive technical evaluations hands-on.</strong> Lead proof-of-concept work with prospects to validate use cases and prove out business outcomes — including light scripting (REST APIs, Python, bash) where needed to close technical gaps.</li> <li><strong>Enable Account Executives.</strong> Provide technical insight, SOAP market context, and prospect feedback that sharpens messaging and accelerates new account acquisition.</li> <li><strong>Stay ahead of the SOAP and AI landscape.</strong> Continuously deepen your understanding of how the market is evolving — from agentic AI and GenAI-powered automation to data pipeline orchestration and self-service automation — and bring that context into every prospect conversation.</li> <li><strong>Uphold Redwood's standards.</strong> Maintain the highest ethical standards across all customer-facing work, representing the company with professionalism and technical credibility at every level of the prospect organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for in how you work:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Resourceful:</strong> You're constantly curious, proactively learning new AI tools and technical capabilities as part of how you operate — not as a side project.</li> <li><strong>Competitive:</strong> You bring initiative, confidence, and a results-oriented mindset to every pursuit.</li> <li><strong>Goal-Oriented:</strong> You set meaningful objectives, track them rigorously, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Detail-Oriented:</strong> You're organized and exercise sound judgment — able to manage multiple technical evaluations and sales cycles simultaneously without things falling through.</li> <li><strong>Communicator:</strong> You can explain SOAP, AI, and automation concepts clearly to both a VP of Engineering and a CFO, and you know the difference matters.</li> <li><strong>Adaptable:</strong> You're comfortable shifting priorities and handling complex, dynamic requirements in a fast-moving enterprise sales environment.</li> </ul> <h2>YOUR EXPERIENCE</h2> <p>The most important thing we're hiring for is technical aptitude and intellectual curiosity. Domain knowledge can be taught — the ability to learn fast, think technically, and communicate clearly cannot.</p> <p><strong>What we require:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or adjacent technical role</strong> in enterprise software — Process Automation, ERP, Data Integration, Business Intelligence, ESB, or similar.</li> <li><strong>Technical aptitude.</strong> Working knowledge of REST APIs and comfort with light scripting (Python, bash, or equivalent) sufficient to build simple integrations, validate technical scenarios, or debug issues in a demo environment. You don't need to be a software engineer — but you need to be comfortable in that world.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools in a professional context</strong> — LLMs, prompt-based workflows, AI-assisted research, AI productivity tooling. This is a baseline requirement, not a differentiator. Bonus if you understand how AI capabilities like observability, intelligent automation, and agentic orchestration are being embedded into enterprise automation platforms specifically.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with agentic AI and AI orchestration concepts.</strong> You understand what multi-agent systems are, how LLMs are being embedded into enterprise workflows, and can hold a substantive conversation with technical buyers about where this is headed.</li> <li><strong>High-level ERP literacy</strong> across core business processes: Financials, Procure to Pay, Plan to Build, Quote to Cash, Reporting, and Data Quality.</li> <li><strong>Ability to bridge technical depth and business value</strong> — credible in a room with enterprise architects, while equally effective communicating ROI to executive stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree</strong> from an accredited college or university.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A head start — not a hard filter. We'll invest in the rest:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior exposure to workload automation, job scheduling, or enterprise orchestration platforms.</li> <li>Familiarity with SAP environments — S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP, or core SAP business processes. We operate deeply in this ecosystem and will develop this knowledge in you.</li> <li>Awareness of data orchestration concepts — ETL/ELT pipelines, DataOps workflows, data movement across hybrid environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps toolchains and how automation intersects with CI/CD, infrastructure provisioning, or SRE practices.</li> <li>Experience in Customer Success, Technical Support, or Professional Services.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="css-1i27f3a"> <div class="css-ey7qxc"> <div class="css-1s1axh3" data-automation-id="jobPostingDescription"> <p><em>If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>THE LEGAL BIT</strong><br>Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy or any other consideration made unlawful by regional or local laws. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities &amp; Energy Trading practice is growing, and we are looking for (Senior) Managers (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">As a (Senior) Manager, you will lead or deliver complex management consulting engagements for clients across commodity and energy trading, build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and help grow our practice. You will combine deep industry expertise with consulting and leadership skills, taking accountability for client outcomes, team performance and commercial development.</span></span></p> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities and large energy consumers. title: Customer Success Engineer
description: As a Customer Success Engineer at vCluster, you aren't just managing accounts — you are the primary architect of customer outcomes after the deal closes. Sitting at the intersection of technical depth and customer strategy, you ensure our customers — from hyper-growth AI Clouds to Global Fortune 500 enterprises — realize the full value of their investment and keep expanding it. You are not a reactive support resource. You are a proactive partner who drives adoption, identifies expansion opportunities, and spots churn before it becomes visible. You build deep relationships with Platform Engineering leaders, DevOps teams, and executive buyers alike — and you can talk credibly with all of them. Your Role and Impact: Onboarding Ownership: Lead end-to-end customer onboardings — from the sales handoff through to project close. You coordinate architecture workshops, platform installation, access setup, integration configuration, and operational readiness reviews. You set the tone for how customers experience vCluster from day one. Success Planning: Build and maintain customer success plans that document business objectives, KPIs, adoption milestones, and a forward plan. You treat the success plan as a living document that drives every customer conversation, not a one-time deliverable that sits in a folder. Value Articulation: Translate platform adoption into business outcomes. You connect Tenant Cluster growth, provisioning time savings, and developer self-service enablement to the metrics your customers care about — cost efficiency, engineering velocity, risk reduction, and platform ROI. When it's time to renew or expand, the business case is already built. Proactive Engagement: Own the customer relationship cadence — regular check-ins, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Executive Business Reviews. You do not wait for the customer and you run executive reviews that reinforce strategic partnership, not just feature updates. Technical Credibility: Hold credible technical conversations with platform engineers, DevOps leads, and architects. You understand the vCluster architecture well enough to discuss Tenant Cluster deployment patterns, RBAC, Tenant Isolation, integrations, and Day 2 operations. You can independently assist the customer with their technical challenges and design optimal deployment architectures. Renewal and Expansion: Own the renewal motion for your accounts — starting 90+ days out. You recognise expansion triggers — new use cases, AI/GPU workloads, additional Tenant Clusters, tier upgrades — and you work with the Account Executive and Solutions Engineer to convert them into growth that solves real customer problems. Customer Advocacy: Serve as the internal voice of your customers. You represent their feature requests, escalate blockers, and provide actionable feedback to Product and Engineering grounded in real account context — not anecdote. This Role is a Fit for You If: Proven Post-Sales Experience: You have experience in a technical post-sales role — customer success, technical account management, or professional services — with a track record of driving adoption and measurable business outcomes across a portfolio of technical customers. Technical Credibility: You have hands-on familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. You can engage with platform engineers on architecture questions, discuss RBAC and Tenant Isolation patterns, and hold your ground in a conversation about cloud infrastructure without bluffing. You know when to bring in deeper technical resources. Stakeholder Range: You can run an executive business review with a Head of Technology in the morning and troubleshoot an onboarding question with a platform engineer in the afternoon. You adapt your communication without losing depth or credibility in either direction. Structured and Proactive: You operate with a clear framework — success plans, adoption milestones, renewal timelines — and you don't need to be reminded to use them. You identify risk before the customer tells you about it. Commercial Awareness: You understand what drives renewal and expansion in a SaaS or platform business. You surface growth opportunities that solve real customer problems, not just opportunities that look good on a pipeline report. Bonus Points For: Kubernetes certification (CKA or CKAD) or equivalent demonstrated technical depth in cloud-native infrastructure. Experience with AI/ML infrastructure, GPU compute environments, or customers building internal developer platforms at scale. Background working with regulated industries — financial services, healthcare, or public sector -- where compliance and governance add complexity to technical decisions. Contributions to the Kubernetes or open-source ecosystem. Experience at a Series B-D startup where you've operated with autonomy and helped build a repeatable post-sales motion from the ground up. About vCluster Labs We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture. We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software. We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems. Benefits We offer the following benefits: Competitive Salary : We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity. Premium Insurance : Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country). Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day. Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way. Culture & Values At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for: Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms. Compensation: €100K – €115K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission Germany • Estimated Base Salary €100K – €115K • Offers Equity • Offers Commission Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
