title: Platform Engineer (gn) @ AI Efficiency Venture, Berlin
description: This is an Atlantic portfolio venture. About the Venture AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up. Frontier labs naturally put their own models first. Companies often follow suit, asking one general-purpose model to handle ten very different jobs. We believe there is far more to unlock in the models that already exist, even before the next generation arrives. That is the opportunity we are building around. We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task. Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one. Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it. About the Role As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath. Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows. You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product. Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will use and help develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to ship quickly, applying the coding fundamentals and judgement needed to stand behind what reaches production. There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through. What You’ll Work On Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops. Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors. Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend. Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation. Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars. Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management. European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models. Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private. The platform will evolve quickly. You will need to move comfortably between improving what exists and learning enough about a new problem to build the next piece well. Our Stack Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo. Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic and LiteLLM. Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq. Frontend: Next.js , React and TypeScript. Cloud and infrastructure: Scaleway, Terraform and Kubernetes for GPU workloads. Auth and secrets: Zitadel, Secret Manager and KMS. Observability and testing: OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Sentry, pytest and testcontainers, alongside frontend testing tools. You should be comfortable with the core backend technologies and ready to learn the rest as the work requires. About You You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step. We are looking for: Experience building and operating production systems: several years of backend engineering with real users, typically three to six, and meaningful ownership of what you shipped. Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus. Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure. Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out. A working understanding of ML systems: familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, evals, model serving and fine-tuning. Experience with LLM APIs, streaming and token costs is a strong plus. Practical agentic engineering experience: you use coding agents effectively and can develop and evaluate their workflows, while independently understanding, reviewing and debugging the code they produce. A disciplined approach to measurement: you benchmark changes, question assumptions and use evidence to understand whether an improvement holds up. Initiative and drive: you enjoy getting deep into a problem, finding a way forward and putting in the work to make it happen. This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team. Fluent English is required; German is a plus. Why Join At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand. The challenge spans AI infrastructure, distributed systems, security and cost efficiency. You will build across those boundaries, take real responsibility early and receive a meaningful equity package in the company you help develop. We are competing with teams that have more people, more funding and an earlier start. Our approach depends on technical depth, focused decisions and the drive to turn them into working software. For someone who enjoys a demanding build, close collaboration and visible impact, there is a lot to get involved in. This is a full-time role, based in our Berlin office five days a week, starting as soon as possible. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

This is an Atlantic portfolio venture.

AI models have moved faster than most companies’ ability to put them to work. The capabilities are there; knowing how to combine them effectively is still catching up.

We bring closed providers and open-weight models together behind a single API. Our engine breaks requests into their component parts, routes each to the right model within a cost budget, fine-tunes on customer data and checks the result against agreed quality standards. With no proprietary model to promote, we can choose the right combination for the task.

Lower costs matter because of what they make possible: giving a small team the freedom to build something that would previously have required a much larger one.

Our founder brings considerable drive, a hands-on approach and a strong sense of urgency to building the company. Backed by Atlantic at pre-seed, we are growing the engineering team to bring the product into production, with people already waiting to use it.

About the Role

As one of our first platform engineers, you will build the foundations that every product feature depends on: the gateway and router, usage and billing systems, customer key management and the European infrastructure underneath.

Much of that platform is still taking shape. Working directly with the founder, CTO and founding AI engineer, you will help turn early architectural decisions into systems that remain reliable as the product grows.

You will take capabilities from design through to production, thinking through their APIs, failure modes, deployment, observability and ongoing operation. In a team this small, building and running the system belong together. You will also work alongside our founding AI engineer on evals, embeddings and open-weight model serving, bringing platform engineering depth to the ML side of the product.

Agentic engineering is central to how we work. You will use and help develop the harnesses and workflows that allow a small team to ship quickly, applying the coding fundamentals and judgement needed to stand behind what reaches production.

There is a lot to build and an ambitious timeline ahead. We work with intensity, move quickly from decisions to execution and value people who take initiative and see things through.

What You’ll Work On

Your first area of ownership will depend on your strengths and our priorities. From there, you will contribute across the platform as it develops.

  • Gateway and routing: build a consistent API across model providers, with reliable streaming, fallbacks and safe handling of retries and provider errors.

  • Cost optimisation: develop caching, history compression and model selection, measuring savings while keeping estimated costs distinct from actual spend.

  • Usage and billing: build accurate accounting for model calls, usage reports, plan entitlements and invoice reconciliation.

  • Agent infrastructure and integrations: support tool calls, cost limits, human approvals and runs that can recover safely from interruptions, alongside connectors for services such as Gmail, Slack and calendars.

  • Tenancy and secrets: maintain workspace isolation, secure authentication and encrypted customer key management.

  • European infrastructure and model serving: build and operate our cloud infrastructure, including the GPU capacity used to serve open-weight models.

  • Production reliability: make systems observable, migrations reversible and releases safe, with tests that protect data integrity and logs that keep customer content and secrets private.

Our backend is built in Python, with a TypeScript frontend in a shared monorepo.

  • Data and queues: Postgres with row-level security and pgvector, Redis and arq.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React and TypeScript.

You enjoy the craft of engineering and the responsibility of seeing your work used in production. Faced with an unclear problem, you can identify what matters, make sensible trade-offs and carry a solution through to release without someone planning every step.

  • Strong Python fundamentals: confidence with async code, typing and testing. TypeScript experience is a plus.

  • Platform engineering depth: practical experience with Postgres, Redis, queues, networking and Terraform. Kubernetes experience is useful, particularly for our GPU infrastructure.

  • Sound engineering judgement: clear APIs, tenant isolation, data integrity, partial failure and safe rollouts. You can explain both your decisions and what you chose to leave out.

This is an experienced individual-contributor role, with ownership of the capabilities you build and close collaboration across the founding team.

Fluent English is required; German is a plus.

At this stage, platform engineering decisions have a direct influence on the product and how quickly the team can build it. You will work close to the founder and CTO, with room to shape the systems you own and see the results of your work first-hand.

Wir bei MaibornWolff sind ein inhabergeführtes, mittelständisches IT-Beratungsunternehmen mit über 30 Jahren Expertise. Mit rund 800 Tech-begeisterten Menschen beraten wir unsere Kunden bei ihren Digitalisierungsstrategien und entwickeln moderne, individuelle Softwarelösungen. 2024 sind wir in die Lünendonk-Liste der „führenden mittelständischen IT-Beratungen in Deutschland" aufgestiegen, worauf wir sehr stolz sind.

In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Unsere Projekte reichen von einzelnen Entwicklungsteams bis hin zu internationalen Programmen in Branchen wie Automotive, Energie und Public Sector.

Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Teams stärken: Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Entwicklungsteams zusammen: Du beseitigst Hindernisse, entwickelst konstruktive Arbeitsweisen weiter und förderst so effektive Teamstrukturen.
  • Stakeholder steuern: Du bringst die unterschiedlichen Interessen von Team, Kunde und MaibornWolff aktiv zusammen und sorgst so für einen klaren, effizienten Entscheidungs- und Kommunikationsfluss.
  • Delivery absichern: Anhand konkreter Kennzahlen machst du Wirkung und Wertbeitrag deiner Rolle sichtbar. Du schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis von Zielen und Erwartungen, beseitigst Hindernisse und adressierst mögliche Risiken frühzeitig.
  • KI-Agenten integrieren: Du befähigst dein Team zur optimalen Einbindung von KI-Agenten und Tools und hast die damit verbundenen Prozess- und Kommunikationsverschiebungen im Blick. Du begleitest Teams und Kunden souverän durch KI-bedingte Change Prozesse.
  • Bereich mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit deiner Delivery Enabler-Gilde entwickelst du unser Rollenverständnis weiter, teilst dein Wissen und treibst relevante Themen voran. Wenn du möchtest, engagierst du dich zusätzlich als Mentor:in in der Mitarbeitendenentwicklung oder in anderen internen Aufgaben.


Dein Profil

  • Ausbildung: Du hast idealerweise ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaft oder IT - entscheidend ist für uns jedoch deine reale Projekterfahrung.
  • Praxiserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3-5 Jahre relevante Projekterfahrung als Scrum Master, Agile Coach oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle innerhalb der Softwareentwicklung mit. Du kennst sowohl die Arbeit auf Teamebene als auch die Koordination über mehrere Teams hinweg, idealerweise ergänzt durch Erfahrung in interkulturellen Kontexten.
  • Methodenkompetenz: Du beherrschst agile Frameworks wie Scrum oder Kanban und bestenfalls auch Skalierungsmodelle wie SAFe, Nexus oder LeSS. Zudem bist du stark in Stakeholder-Management, Facilitation & Workshop-Design sowie in agilen Metriken und Forecasting. Vielleicht hast du sogar bereits Erfahrungen mit OKRs, Flight Levels oder im Value Stream Mapping gesammelt. 
  • Tools: Du nutzt KI-Anwendungen routiniert und zielgerichtet für deine eigene Arbeitseffizienz. Zudem hast du durch deine Projektarbeit ein klares Verständnis zu Wirkweise und möglichen Fallstricken von KI in der Softwareentwicklung gewonnen.
  • Reisebereitschaft: 
     Du bist bereit, bei Bedarf bis zu zwei Tage pro Woche zu reisen – für Workshops, Team-Events oder den direkten Austausch mit Team und Kunden vor Ort.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und sehr gutes Englisch.


Deine Benefits

  • New Work. Home Office & Office, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Teilzeitmodelle, Arbeitszeitkonto, Sabbatical
  • Weiterbildung. 1,5 Bruttomonatsgehälter stehen jährlich bereit, damit du deinen Horizont erweitern kannst.
  • Mitarbeiterevents. Ob Firmenseminare im Sommer oder Weihnachtsfeiern, wir feiern die kleinen und großen Anlässe.
  • Betriebliche Leistungen. Zuzahlung zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Mobilitätsbudget und Sport-Angebot.
  • Forschung & Entwicklung. Stecke deine Nase bewusst auch in andere Themen rein.
  • Moderne Hard- und Software. iPhone, MacBook, Lenovo-Notebook, moderne Büroausstattung.


Du hast Fragen?

description: Die Position BERLIN · a b sofort · befristet bis 31.12.2027 Teilzeit – 32 Std./Woche | Besetzung vorbehaltlich der Mittelzusage Bewerbungsfrist: 30.09.2026, 13.00 Uhr Du möchtest gesellschaftlich relevante Themen verständlich, sensibel und zielgruppengerecht erzählen? Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und politische Bildungsarbeit – und willst Inhalte und Kampagnen für ein antisemitismuskritisches Bildungsprojekt entwickeln, die junge Menschen erreichen? Dann werde Teil von GermanDream. Über uns GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Mit unseren Begegnungsformaten, Bildungsprogrammen sowie durch Vernetzungs- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit vermitteln wir nachhaltig die Werte des Grundgesetzes – im Klassenzimmer, im Alltag und überall dort, wo Menschen zusammenkommen. Mit dem Projekt DECODED – Antisemitismus in Popkultur und Medien erweitern wir unsere antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit in Berlin. Gemeinsam mit jüdischen Künstler:innen, Expert:innen und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen machen wir antisemitische Codes, Sprachbilder und digitale Dynamiken sichtbar. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Workshops mit Jugendlichen, Qualifizierungen für Lehrkräfte, digitale Inhalte und weitere Formate. Deine Rolle Du koordinierst und gestaltest die kommunikative Umsetzung des Projekts – von der Redaktions- und Contentplanung bis zur Veröffentlichung: Du schreibst Texte, gestaltest Grafiken, konzipierst Videoformate, begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen, filmst selbst mit und schneidest kurze Videoformate. Dabei übersetzt du die fachlichen Themen des Projekts in verständliche, sensible und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle – von Reels, Posts, Sharepics und Story-Formaten bis hin zu Website-Texten, Newsletter-Inhalten und begleitenden Kommunikationsmaterialien für Bildungsangebote und Veranstaltungen. Du bereitest Einblicke aus der Projektarbeit redaktionell und visuell auf und behältst dabei Redaktionspläne, Termine, Abstimmungen und benötigte Materialien im Blick. So trägst du dazu bei, dass die Themen und Angebote des Projektes unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen, jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll sichtbar werden und antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit auch im digitalen Raum Wirkung entfalten kann. Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet Content, Redaktion und Storytelling Du planst, erstellst und veröffentlichst Inhalte für die Projektkommunikation für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und unsere Öffentlichkeitsarbeit. Du bereitest komplexe fachliche Inhalte verständlich, niedrigschwellig und zielgruppengerecht auf. Du gestaltest Texte, Posts, Kurzvideos und weitere digitale Formate rund um die Themen und Aktivitäten des Projekts. Du erzählst Geschichten aus Workshops, Qualifizierungen, Kooperationen und Veranstaltungen und machst die Menschen und Perspektiven hinter dem Projekt sichtbar. Du betreust die projektbezogenen Inhalte auf den Social-Media-Kanälen von GermanDream und sorgst für eine verlässliche Veröffentlichung. Du planst und begleitest Veranstaltungen, Videodrehs, Interviews und Videoporträts, breitest Fragen und Abläufe vor und stimmst dich dazu mit allen Beteiligten ab. Du begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen vor Ort, filmst selbst mit und sammelst geeignetes Foto-, Video- und O-Ton-Material. Du schneidest kurze Videoformate selbst und koordinierst weitere Kommunikationsmaßnahmen gemeinsam mit internen und externen Beteiligten. Du bereitest Inhalte, Materialien und Ergebnisse aus dem Projekt für unsere Kommunikationskanäle auf. Du greifst relevante Entwicklungen und Debatten in Popkultur, Medien und digitalen Räumen auf und entwickelst daraus passende Kommunikationsansätze. Zusammenarbeit, Planung und Auswertung Du arbeitest eng mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektmanagement und den eingebundenen Fachrollen zusammen und stimmst fachlich sensible Inhalte eng mit ihnen ab. raw.description:
Die Position

BERLIN · ab sofort · befristet bis 31.12.2027 

Teilzeit – 32 Std./Woche | Besetzung vorbehaltlich der Mittelzusage

Bewerbungsfrist: 30.09.2026, 13.00 Uhr 


Du möchtest gesellschaftlich relevante Themen verständlich, sensibel und zielgruppengerecht erzählen? Du hast ein Gespür für Social Media, Storytelling und politische Bildungsarbeit – und willst Inhalte und Kampagnen für ein antisemitismuskritisches Bildungsprojekt entwickeln, die junge Menschen erreichen? Dann werde Teil von GermanDream.


Über uns

GermanDream ist Deutschlands präsenteste Bildungsbewegung für gelebte Demokratie und Teilhabe. Mit unseren Begegnungsformaten, Bildungsprogrammen sowie durch Vernetzungs- und Öffentlichkeitsarbeit vermitteln wir nachhaltig die Werte des Grundgesetzes – im Klassenzimmer, im Alltag und überall dort, wo Menschen zusammenkommen.

Mit dem Projekt DECODED – Antisemitismus in Popkultur und Medien erweitern wir unsere antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit in Berlin. Gemeinsam mit jüdischen Künstler:innen, Expert:innen und weiteren Kooperationspartner:innen machen wir antisemitische Codes, Sprachbilder und digitale Dynamiken sichtbar. Wir stärken Jugendliche, Lehrkräfte und pädagogische Fachkräfte darin, Antisemitismus zu erkennen, einzuordnen und ihm handlungssicher zu begegnen. Im Mittelpunkt stehen Workshops mit Jugendlichen, Qualifizierungen für Lehrkräfte, digitale Inhalte und weitere Formate.


Deine Rolle


Du koordinierst und gestaltest die kommunikative Umsetzung des Projekts – von der Redaktions- und Contentplanung bis zur Veröffentlichung: Du schreibst Texte, gestaltest Grafiken, konzipierst Videoformate, begleitest Workshops, Drehs und Veranstaltungen, filmst selbst mit und schneidest kurze Videoformate.

Dabei übersetzt du die fachlichen Themen des Projekts in verständliche, sensible und zielgruppengerechte Inhalte für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und weitere Kanäle – von Reels, Posts, Sharepics und Story-Formaten bis hin zu Website-Texten, Newsletter-Inhalten und begleitenden Kommunikationsmaterialien für Bildungsangebote und Veranstaltungen.

Du entwickelst Formate und Kampagnen in enger Abstimmung mit deiner direkten Führungskraft, dem Projektteam und den eingebundenen Fachrollen. Du bereitest Einblicke aus der Projektarbeit redaktionell und visuell auf und behältst dabei Redaktionspläne, Termine, Abstimmungen und benötigte Materialien im Blick.

So trägst du dazu bei, dass die Themen und Angebote des Projektes unterschiedliche Zielgruppen erreichen, jüdische Perspektiven respektvoll sichtbar werden und antisemitismuskritische Bildungsarbeit auch im digitalen Raum Wirkung entfalten kann.



Was dich in dieser Rolle erwartet

Content, Redaktion und Storytelling
  • Du planst, erstellst und veröffentlichst Inhalte für die Projektkommunikation für Social Media, Website, Newsletter und unsere Öffentlichkeitsarbeit.

title: Senior Fullstack Entwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) - Remote, 4-Tage-Woche
description: Intro Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig! Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert . Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen. In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten , die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack. Deine Aufgaben Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte. Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen. Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir. Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder. Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam. Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen. Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team. Dein Profil Technisch Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams. Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen. Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit. Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design. Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch. Nice to Have, aber kein Muss DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud) Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL) Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails) Persönlich Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets. Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg. Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft. Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt. Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation. KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht. Warum wir? Code. Chill. Repeat. 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an. Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung. Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor. Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln. Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl. Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper. Dein Weg zu uns Keine Lust auf lange Anschreiben? Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach kurz, warum du Teil vom Händlerbund werden möchtest und warum wir gut zu dir passen. Nutze dazu die Möglichkeit dich online über unser Bewerbungsformular zu bewerben. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins. Falls du Fragen zu diesem Job hast, wende dich bitte per E-Mail an unseren HR Manager Lisa Winkler : ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, UGV Platforms (m/f/d)
description: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real world operations. As Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, you will own electromagnetic compatibility across our UGV platforms, starting with our Mandrill UGV: from the grounding and shielding concept on the drawing board to the certificate that puts our vehicles on public roads and into military service. Your goal is one robust E/E design baseline that passes civil homologation (UN ECE R10) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461, AECTP 500) without costly redesign loops. This is a senior engineer role with real ownership and room to grow. You build our EMC capability from the ground up, set the strategy, decide early in the design, and lead campaigns through to certification. You will work at the intersection of high power electronics, vehicle E/E, radios and mission payloads, autonomy compute, suppliers, test houses and authorities. As the platform family and team grow, this role can develop into leading our EMC and compliance function. What is your Day to Day Mission: EMC Strategy and Compliance Ownership Define and own the EMC and E3 compliance strategy for our UGV platforms, covering civil vehicle approval (UN ECE R10, E mark for vehicle and ESA) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461G, MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500 / AECTP 250, MIL-STD-1275). Translate customer, NATO and national requirements into an EMC control plan, requirement matrix and test strategy, and keep them current as configurations evolve. Act as the technical interface to accredited test houses, technical services, type approval authorities and defence customers during qualification and acceptance. EMC by Design Develop and integrate the grounding, bonding, shielding and harness concept for the complete vehicle, with special focus on high voltage and high power electronics: traction inverters, DC/DC converters, battery systems and chargers together with outstanding team of engineers Run EMC design reviews for schematics, PCBs, harnesses, enclosures and connectors; specify filters, transient protection and shielding concepts. Manage RF coexistence on a dense platform: datalinks, GNSS, tactical radios and payload emitters working side by side without degrading each other. Flow down EMC requirements to suppliers, run component level reviews and assess their test evidence. Test, Troubleshooting and Qualification Build our in house pre compliance lab (LISN, spectrum analyser, near field probes, current clamps, automated measurement scripts) so issues are found on the bench, not in the chamber. Plan, witness and lead full compliance campaigns at component, subsystem and vehicle level; drive root cause analysis and verified fixes when tests fail. Use simulation (e.g. FEKO, CST, LTspice) where it saves test iterations. Cross Functional Collaboration and Standards Work closely with payload integration, vehicle E/E, mechanical, autonomy and manufacturing teams so EMC is built in, not bolted on. Create EMC control plans, test procedures, reports and qualification evidence, and turn lessons learned into internal EMC design rules for every future platform and payload. title: Enterprise Solutions Architect (gn)
description: Einleitung Enterprise Solution Architect (gn) Schwerpunkt EAM-Plattform und Governance Wie oft im Leben bekommt man die Chance, Enterprise Architecture nicht zu reparieren, sondern von null aufzubauen? Die meisten EAM-Rollen beginnen mit einem Erbe: ein Tool, das vor Jahren jemand anderes gekauft hat, ein Repository mit Stand von vorgestern, eine Community, die sich aus Pflicht trifft. Diese Rolle beginnt mit einem leeren Blatt. Unser Mandant, ein international tätiger Dienstleistungskonzern mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, stellt seine IT gerade organisatorisch neu auf. Die Holding, die alle Geschäftsbereiche steuert, baut dabei Enterprise Architecture Management als eigenständige Funktion auf, mit eigenem Tooling, eigenen Prozessen und konzernweiter Geltung. Tool-Auswahl, Metamodell, Governance: nichts davon ist entschieden. Das wird deine Entscheidung. Solche Konstellationen gibt es selten und sie halten nicht lange. In zwei Jahren ist die neue IT-Organisation gesetzt, und wer dann kommt, arbeitet in Strukturen, die jemand anderes gebaut hat. Jetzt ist der Moment, in dem man sie baut. Worum es geht Enterprise Architecture scheitert selten an fehlenden Frameworks. Sie scheitert daran, dass niemand das Repository pflegt, das Tool nicht mit den Quellsystemen spricht und die Architektur-Community nach dem dritten Meeting einschläft. Diese Rolle verhindert genau das. Du baust die Grundlage, auf der EAM in diesem Konzern funktioniert. Prozesse, die Menschen tatsächlich befolgen. Eine Plattform, die ihre Daten automatisiert bezieht, statt dass jemand sie abtippt. Deine Aufgaben Du definierst, wie Architekturarbeit im Konzern abläuft: Prozessmodelle, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Beschreibungen und Anforderungskataloge. Du wählst das EAM-Tool aus, von der Marktsondierung über die Ausschreibung bis zur Entscheidung, und verantwortest danach Implementierung und Konfiguration. Du konzipierst die Anbindung an Konfigurationsdatenbank, Service-Management und Cloud-Umgebungen, damit das Repository aktuell bleibt, ohne dass jemand es manuell nachführt. Du entwickelst das Architektur-Metamodell weiter, wenn Geschäft oder Technologie es verlangen und misst die Reife der Prozesse regelmäßig gegen Industriestandards. Du probierst neue Methoden aus, etwa Capability Maps oder Wertstromanalysen, und entscheidest, was davon in diesen Konzern passt. Du sorgst für Betrieb und Skalierbarkeit der Plattform, inklusive Rollen und Zugriffskonzepten und definierst Kennzahlen für Datenqualität. Du entwirfst Schulungs- und Onboarding-Formate, pflegst die Dokumentation und schreibst die Leitfäden, die neue Nutzende wirklich lesen. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Solution- oder Enterprise-Architektur , gern mit technischer Leitungsverantwortung für eine gewachsene IT-Landschaft. Praxis in Einführung und Administration eines marktgängigen EAM-Tools, etwa Ardoq, LeanIX, Sparx EA oder vergleichbar. Sichere Anwendung gängiger Architektur-Frameworks wie TOGAF oder ArchiMate, idealerweise zertifiziert. Erfahrung mit Architektur-Boards oder Communities, und ein Gespür dafür, wie man sie am Leben hält. Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Benefits Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit in einer Konzernholding mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Ein sicherer Arbeitgeber! Eine Rolle, die es in dieser Form vorher nicht gab, mit entsprechendem Gestaltungsspielraum. Individuelle Weiterbildung, von Fachtrainings bis Coaching. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Option, mobil zu arbeiten (hybrid). Externe, kostenfreie vertrauliche Beratung zu beruflichen und privaten Themen. description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Sayari:&nbsp;</strong></h2> <div> <p>Sayari is the judgment infrastructure for trustworthy AI in economic security and commercial risk. The Sayari Commercial World Model resolves 11.7B+ primary-source records from 250+ jurisdictions forming the ground truth of global commerce. A Judgment Ontology, encoding over a decade of investigative tradecraft, and Superconductor, an agentic orchestration platform, deliver AI that reasons like an expert analyst, shows its work, and traces every finding to its source. Trusted by U.S. Customs and Border Protection, HM Revenue &amp; Customs, and Fortune 500 enterprises, Sayari is used by thousands of professionals across 35+ countries to secure supply chains and dismantle illicit networks. Headquartered in Washington, D.C., with offices in London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Tel Aviv.</p> </div></div><h3><strong>POSITION DESCRIPTION</strong></h3> <p>This is not a traditional sales engineering role. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you are at the critical intersection of our code, our clients, and their most critical missions. You will be deployed to our most strategic partners, embedding within their environments to solve high-stakes problems that have no textbook answers.</p> <p>You own the "last mile" of our product's impact , ensuring our technology fundamentally transforms how our users confront challenges such as financial crime, supply chain disruption, and threats to national security.</p> <p>You are equal parts engineer, strategist, and operator. One day you might be architecting a data pipeline within a client's cloud environment ; the next, you'll be writing production Python to integrate our API into a proprietary analytics platform ; and by the end of the week, you could be briefing a C-level executive, intelligence analyst, or mission director on the outcomes your work has enabled.</p> <p>You thrive on ambiguity, operate with extreme ownership, and are relentless in your pursuit of delivering real-world value. You will act as a vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams, turning your bespoke solutions into scalable, platform-wide features of Sayari’s product suite.</p> <p><strong>At Sayari, we’re always looking for great talent to join our team. This is a proactive hiring post for future Forward Deployed Engineer roles, allowing us to connect with amazing candidates like you before a specific seat opens up.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>JOB RESPONSIBILITIES</strong></h4> <ul> <li><strong>Embed and Build:</strong> Deploy directly into our clients' technical ecosystems and work with key stakeholders to understand their unique workflows, technical environments, and mission challenges. Design, build, and ship production-grade code. You will write robust Python applications, advanced SQL, and leverage our APIs to solve bespoke challenges at the edge.</li> <li><strong>Own the Outcome:</strong> Lead the entire technical lifecycle of our most strategic deployments, from initial discovery and architectural design to implementation and operationalization. You are responsible for ensuring our platform delivers tangible, mission-critical value.</li> <li><strong>Be the Tip of the Spear:</strong> Serve as the primary technical authority for our clients. You'll lead deep-dive technical workshops, debug complex systems, and act as a trusted, hands-on advisor on how to best leverage Sayari's platform to achieve their objectives in real-world investigations and missions.</li> <li><strong>Engineer Solutions for the Mission:</strong> Deconstruct ambiguous, high-level mission requirements into concrete technical solutions. Architect and implement scalable data models and workflows, ranging from building robust data pipelines into client persistence layers (Snowflake, Databricks, etc.) to developing custom Python scripts and prototyping AI/ML models.</li> <li><strong>Shape Our Product:</strong> Act as the vital conduit between the front lines and our core engineering teams. You will translate complex, real-world operational needs and feedback into the next generation of Sayari's platform.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>SKILLS &amp; EXPERIENCE</strong></h4> <p><em>Required:</em></p> <ul> <li>5+ years of experience in a client-facing, technical role (Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Consulting, etc.).</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to write clean, production-ready code, with strong proficiency in programming languages (preferably Python) and its data manipulation ecosystem (Pandas, etc.).</li> <li>Deep fluency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries.</li> <li>Hands-on, practical experience consuming, integrating, and reasoning about RESTful APIs.</li> <li>Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between code and mission. You can articulate highly technical concepts with clarity and conviction to engineers, analysts, and senior leaders alike.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to navigate ambiguous, complex scenarios.</li> <li>A relentless drive and intellectual curiosity. You are comfortable parachuting into new environments and learning new technologies on the fly.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field strongly preferred</li> </ul> <p><em>Desired:</em></p> <ul> <li>Practical experience leveraging AI, including prompting Large Language Models (LLMs) or using their APIs to build analytical solutions.</li> <li>Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).</li> <li>Familiarity with the modern data stack (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) and workflow orchestrators (e.g., Airflow, Prefect).</li> <li>Knowledge of graph data technologies (Neo4j, TigerGraph) and their corresponding query languages.</li> <li>Exposure to machine learning applications, particularly in NLP or entity resolution.</li> <li>Experience in, or a demonstrated passion for, high-stakes domains such as AML/Financial Crime, Supply Chain Risk, or National Security.</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Ability to travel up to 50%</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>The target base salary for this position is £100,000 to £110,000 plus commission and equity. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, candidate experience and expertise, internal peer equity, and may vary from the amounts listed above.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Benefits:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <div> <ul> <li>100% fully paid medical, vision, and dental for employees and their dependents</li> <li>Generous time off; we observe all US federal holidays, close our office for a winter break (12/24-12/31), in addition to granting 18 PTO days and 10 sick days</li> <li>Outstanding compensation package; competitive commissions for revenue roles and bonuses for non-revenue positions</li> <li>A strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion</li> <li>Eligibility to participate in additional benefits such as 401k match up to 5%, 100% paid life insurance (up to $100,000 coverage),, and parental leave</li> <li>A collaborative and positive culture - your team will be as smart and driven as you</li> <li>Limitless growth and learning opportunities</li> </ul> </div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Sayari is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace and a fair recruitment process. Covers centralised production hubs and the resources, infrastructure, controls and services required to support Worldwide and Geo demand, including permanent and flexible capacity. Test scenarios for changes in volume, complexity, timing and location. Work with Delivery, SMEs and Geo leaders to allocate shared resources, manage utilisation and productivity, protect service levels and balance work across hubs. Identify bottlenecks early and agree actions rather than relying on local workarounds. Ensure employment classification and local legal or tax questions go to the accountable specialists. Lead operational readiness for Workshops and other surges, including space, technology, security, access, staffing, shifts, supplier support and contingency capacity. Own the operational response to a hub disruption. Keep tested continuity and recovery plans, including transfer options, cross training, access dependencies and client approvals where required. Ensure work is coded and measured consistently so actual demand, effort and cost can be compared with the model. Partner with Commercial and Finance on forecast accuracy, capacity pool economics, the minimum spend commitment, margin, scope changes, rush requests and Workshop demand. Identify the operational causes of variance and propose corrective actions; do not change prices or commitments without the agreed approval route. Supply a reliable monthly operational pack covering volumes and complexity, capacity and utilisation, forecast accuracy, service levels, quality, revisions and exceptions. Support quarterly commercial reviews of spend, margin, demand, savings and capacity risks, and the annual review of unit prices, cost adjustment, efficiency commitment and baseline capacity. Drive measurable productivity and the contracted efficiency commitment through improved planning, workflow, automation and location mix while protecting quality, security and sustainable capacity. Validate savings with Finance and avoid double counting. Ensure hub financial procedures, hiring controls, approved rates, procurement and contractor processes are followed. Use the data to diagnose recurring constraints and measure whether interventions work. Partner with Technology and process owners on rollout of production tools, language capacity planning, freelancer management and workflow improvements. Ensure local teams are trained and changes are embedded. People, partnerships and risk Lead, coach and assess Hub Operations Leads. Build an integrated leadership team with clear expectations, succession cover and consistent management standards across locations. Build trusted relationships with senior Delivery, Geo, capability and client operations stakeholders. Make trade offs visible, resolve competing priorities and communicate decisions with clarity. Oversee hub risks relating to security, confidentiality, health and safety, infrastructure, service continuity and local compliance. Maintain a visible risk and action log, with owners and deadlines, and escalate issues that need executive decisions. Measures of success Reliable delivery against agreed service levels, quality and security requirements across the hub network. Capacity and forecast accuracy by pool, with healthy utilisation, controlled overtime and a clear response to peaks and gaps. raw.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Allica Bank has won multiple recent Commercial Mortgage awards with the CM products being the main driver of lending in the Allica suite, the Commercial Mortgage products have now been well established for over 2 years and continue to grow at pace as a market leader. As part of the risk function within Commercial Mortgages, this role is critical to ensure we can deliver on our objectives in a safe manner.

Role Description

The purpose of the role is to underwrite borrowing requests received via a variety of channels, including online in line with the Bank’s approved Credit Policy and in accordance with the Banks asset portfolio (including but not limited to commercial mortgages, commercial investment loans, commercial loans against leasehold properties) .

Principle Accountabilities

  • Assess and underwrite direct credit loan applications within personal discretion, in line with the all regulatory requirements, the Bank’s credit appetite policy and underwriting policies utilising appropriate credit data and analytical tools.

  • Produce clear, accurate and concise written documentation, making clear recommendations to the Credit team for loan application requests falling outside of personal discretion or outside of credit policy, escalating cases where necessary to the appropriate Delegated Lending Authorities.

  • Manage and own the end to end application process, from initial enquiry to completion, liaising effectively with the panel solicitors in terms of required security instructions and ensure loans are appropriately documented and borrowing is fully secured before draw-down.

  • Liaise with the Credit team as required in managing the credit risk environment, concentration risk and developing credit policy.

  • Undertake regular checks and monitor agreed controls to ensure the Bank’s risk and customer requirements are met at all times; escalating immediately any areas of concern

  • Manage a portfolio of advances to a defined arrears and collections policy.

  • Liaise effectively with applicants (or their brokers) and valuers in requests for additional relevant information to support the credit decisioning process.

  • Deliver an excellent service is given to customers, their brokers and Relationship Managers, building and maintaining strong relationships in line with the Bank’s values and defined customer experience standards.

  • Ensure compliance with all mandatory policies and adherence to credit procedures to maintain internal credit controls.

  • Fully understand and comply with operational procedures, requirements and SLA’s.

  • Help develop appropriate MI and KPI indicators and reporting, maintaining suitable MI to enable a detailed understanding of Mortgage processing pipeline

  • Actively search for areas of improvement for the Bank and your team and take ownership for delivery of these, setting a good example by displaying appropriate values and behaviour

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Exposure/knowledge of underwriting, with experience in the SME sector, with an understanding of the competitor landscape and the dynamics and trends of the SME market.

  • Excellent credit/financial analysis skills including the analysis of financial accounts, budgets and cashflow forecasting, Understanding of the loan underwriting process and the risks involved and be able to assess applications within a personal discretion and make recommendations and take commercial decisions.

  • Experience of escalating and presenting at Credit Committee level and Arrears Management.

  • Strong analytical, verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to build strong and lasting relationships with internal stakeholders such as the distribution team, operations team and senior management, plus 3rd party suppliers such as Intermediaries, Valuers and Solicitors.

  • Understand and comply with all regulatory requirements, plus internal policies / procedures, guidelines, risks and controls and service levels.

  • Good understanding of TCF, AML, KYC and Conduct risk.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

description: About Us We’re living through a Cambrian explosion of intelligence: new models and new chips, each specialised for different tasks, are arriving all at once. The result is a new era for AI, one of radical heterogeneity. Callosum is the Intelligent Systems Company. We believe the next generation of AI won't be defined by any single model or chip, but by intelligent systems in which hardware and intelligence co-evolve. We are building the infrastructure that unifies heterogeneous compute across the full stack. This opens a new axis of scaling intelligence: a dynamic system that tailors itself to what each workload actually needs, whether that's speed, cost, precision, or whatever unit comes next. The last era scaled on a different bet: one bigger model, more of the same chip, more data. That bet is running into structural limits. Frontier models offer extraordinary capability at unsustainable cost, one that today's monolithic infrastructure was never designed to serve. Our founding principle is that intelligence comes from many specialised systems working together, not from any single component. We build the software orchestration layer that co-evolves models, workflows and silicon into one system, delivering inference tailored to every workload, and demonstrating orders-of-magnitude leaps in capability and cost. Because our software spans the full stack, our engineering team works directly with heterogeneous accelerators and frontier silicon, including Cerebras, d-Matrix, Intel, NVIDIA, AMD, Normal Computing, Tenstorrent, GreatSky, and Mixx. We are not stopping at today's chips: each new generation of silicon unlocks algorithms that couldn't run before, and we intend to be first to them, every time. If we get it right, it will belong to everyone building on it - not to any single vendor. In our latest funding round, we raised $100M, led by Atomico with participation from Plural, DCVC and the UK Sovereign AI Fund’s first investment. With this, we are building the infrastructure for the next era of intelligence. We are engineers and scientists based in London, working across the full depth of the stack. We are curious, intellectually honest, and building what doesn't exist yet. If you thrive on uncharted territory and are energised by the scale of the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role The Applied AI team own Callosum's customer engagements end to end. You will work directly with customer engineering teams to understand their AI workloads, design and run rigorous evaluations against their production pipelines, integrate optimised workflows into their systems, and make sure the results hold in production. At Callosum, Applied AI Engineers are the technical bridge between what customers run and what we build. What you learn shapes the research and platform roadmap. The evaluations you run are how we prove the technology in production. As an early member of the team, you will help build the methodology, tooling, and engagement practices the function runs on. You will work closely with the engineers designing new intelligent systems, with the platform team that serves them, and directly with senior technical stakeholders on the customer side. title: Founding Product Builder, Operations
description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software. Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it. The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too. We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else. What you'll own Triage: Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself. Cost per deal: There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them. Automation: You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached. Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it. The ops team: You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them. What we're looking for You build, not buy: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. Buying a tool or setting up workflows in Sheets doesn't count. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar. Founder or product DNA: You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start. Systems thinker: You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it. A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that. In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done. Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting. Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. We care much more about the traits you have and the things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. How we work There are five things we care about deeply: Reason from the ground up Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts. Speed begets speed We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin. Take ownership Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to. Brutal honesty If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to. Truly excellent customer service Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster. This role is probably not for you if You'd rather write specs and hand tickets to engineers than build the thing yourself; You prefer close management of your responsibilities; You are risk-averse; You want a 9-5; You take yourself too seriously; You care about working for a company that's raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact Salary £90k - £120k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity. Hiring process Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. A call with our Head of People, an in-person session with the founders where you solve a real Odin problem end to end with AI, then a final with the founders. The last two can run on the same day. raw.description:
Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets.
We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in.

Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits.

We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors.

Why we're hiring

  • We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled builders like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software.

  • This is a product role, and your product is how Odin operates. Think of it as our ghostbuster: every operational problem lands with you, you decide what gets fixed, and you ship most of the fixes yourself rather than writing tickets for someone else.

  • We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast.

  • Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we'll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone.

  • The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows.

  • We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software.

  • Odin's operations run on around 50 processes, some code and some people, and plenty still held together by spreadsheets. Your job is to take each one apart, question why it exists, then rebuild it or kill it.

  • The simplest way to think about it: the numerator is how many deals we close, the denominator is what each deal costs us to run. You'll focus on the denominator, and the right person won't be able to stop themselves thinking about the numerator too.

  • We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else.

What you'll own

  • Triage: Every operational problem comes to you before it reaches product and engineering. For each one you decide: scope it so precisely that engineering knows exactly what to build, or build it yourself.

  • Cost per deal: There will be big early wins where a whole process can be ripped out and replaced. After that, doubling ops efficiency comes from 150 small changes, and you'll be the one making them.

  • Automation: You'll sit with the deal operations team, learn each workflow end to end, then build what replaces it. Most of what you ship you'll build without engineering. What does go to them arrives simple, scoped and usually with a working prototype attached.

  • Deleting things and saying no: You decide what belongs in our processes and what doesn't. If a request from sales doesn't scale and isn't highly profitable we don't do it. If a way of working exists for no good reason, you kill it.

  • The ops team: You'll lead the core deal operations team, deciding where their time goes while you rebuild the work around them.

What we're looking for

  • You build, not buy: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built real solutions with AI with no budget and no engineers. Buying a tool or setting up workflows in Sheets doesn't count. We want to see what you've shipped in Claude Code or similar.

  • Founder or product DNA: You've founded something, been early on a founding team, or worked as a product manager. That usually means four or more years of experience and a track record of finishing what you start.

  • Systems thinker: You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? You think about the whole business, not just your corner of it.
    A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that.

  • In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done.

  • Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You'll be automating a lot of numerical work - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting.

  • Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. We care much more about the traits you have and the things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV.

How we work

There are five things we care about deeply:

  1. Reason from the ground up
    Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts.

  2. Speed begets speed
    We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin.

  3. Take ownership
    Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to.

  4. Brutal honesty
    If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to.

  5. Truly excellent customer service
    Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster.

This role is probably not for you if

  • You'd rather write specs and hand tickets to engineers than build the thing yourself;

  • You prefer close management of your responsibilities;

  • You are risk-averse;

  • You want a 9-5;

  • You take yourself too seriously;

  • You care about working for a company that's raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact

Salary

£90k - £120k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity.

Hiring process

Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. A call with our Head of People, an in-person session with the founders where you solve a real Odin problem end to end with AI, then a final with the founders. The last two can run on the same day.

Location & ways of working

We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office.

Benefits

  • Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support

  • Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness

  • Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave

  • Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally

title: Senior Data Analyst – Labour & Productivity
description: <p><strong>The Role..</strong></p> <p>We are starting a labour optimisation programme with our Operations team, alongside FP&amp;A and Data Science. The aim is to improve our wage percentage to sales while improving service standards at the same time. We are not interested in an approach that delivers one at the expense of the other.</p> <p>We are currently selecting an advanced scheduling platform to support this. The analytical foundation underneath it,how we measure productivity, what our labour standards are, how good our demand forecasts need to be - is what this role owns.</p> <p>You will sit in the Data team and work in close partnership with FP&amp;A. Analysis alone will not move the number; changes stick when a Finance Business Partner and a General Manager can see the opportunity in their own House, agree the size of it and hold it in their forecast. Your job is to give them that, in a form they can act on.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities..</strong></p> <ul> <li>Labour productivity analysis, identifying site-by-site opportunities for efficiency gains and sizing each one</li> <li>Work with Operations and Finance to trial changes to scheduling and measure their impact</li> <li>Build improved labour reporting, so Business Partners and GMs can see productivity, schedule changes and shift adherence on a daily and weekly cadence</li> <li>Support Finance translate demand forecasts into labour requirements, helping to build the models that turn covers, check-ins, treatments and occupancy into hours by role</li> <li>Partner with our Data Science and Operations teams to understand forecast accuracy and recommend improvements</li> <li>Connect labour deployment to member experience, so that productivity gains are demonstrably not coming out of the House</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">What we are looking for..</span></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in labour optimisation. You have personally delivered measurable improvement in wage percentage or sales per labour hour in a multi-site operation, and can talk us through the levers you pulled, how you sized them and how you proved the result</li> <li>A track record of partnering finance and operational stakeholders to land change, not just report on it</li> <li>Several years in an analytics role, with genuine multi-site operational exposure — hospitality, retail, leisure or QSR</li> <li>Advanced SQL, and comfort in a modelled data warehouse (experience with dbt an advantage)</li> <li>BI development experience (Omni, Looker, Tableau or Power BI), building tools operators actually use</li> <li>Experience with rota, time and attendance and payroll data, and a realistic view of its challenges</li> <li>Able to evaluate a demand forecast critically — accuracy, bias, seasonality — without needing to build one</li> </ul> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Desirable..</span></p> <ul> <li>Experience with a workforce management or scheduling platform — Unifocus, HotSchedules, Dayforce, Fourth, S4 Labour, UKG, Quinyx or similar</li> <li>Strong financial modelling and fluency in P&amp;L mechanics — wage percentage, flow-through, contribution</li> <li>An understanding of how labour regulation constrains labour models internationally, particularly the US — predictive scheduling and fair workweek rules, overtime and break requirements</li> <li>Labour standards or time-and-motion experience</li> <li>Python for data analysis and modelling, and/or use of AI tooling such as Claude Code to accelerate it</li> <li>Experience linking labour deployment to customer experience outcomes</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits..</strong></p> <p>Soho House offers competitive compensation packages that feature global benefits and perks. Whether you’re seeking entry-level employment or a new opportunity to expand your profession, we offer training to develop the technical and managerial skills necessary to grow your career.</p> <ul> <li>Discounts at Soho House globally, as well as Soho Home and Cowshed</li> <li>Annual Every House Membership</li> <li>Enhanced Pension Scheme</li> <li>Private Health and Dental Care</li> <li>Cycle to Work Scheme/Season Ticket Loan</li> <li>In conjunction with Soho Impact, take 3 days paid a year to support a charity of your choice.</li> <li>Cookhouse &amp; House Tonic: Our Cookhouse &amp; House Tonic programmes offer unique food and drink trainings, events and opportunities to inspire and educate.</li> <li>Team Events: From fitness sessions to cinema screenings and art classes, each month we hold a series of fun events which you can sign up to.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
