About Lendable

Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:

  • One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

  • Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

  • Profitable since 2017

  • Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

  • Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot)

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.

We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.

Join us if you want to

  1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

  2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

  3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

About the team

Lendable is the UK market leader in real rate risk-based pricing, offering consumers transparency and product assurance at the point of application. Data Science and Analytics sits at the heart of this, developing the credit risk models and strategies to underwrite loan and credit card products.

Our team is primarily focused on the pricing domain but we also work on other areas including product and credit. We implement a range of machine learning techniques and analytical tools to continually improve our product offering.

About the role

You will be working in the UK Loans team at Lendable and will work on projects related to pricing, funnel and credit optimisation in collaboration with the credit and product teams.

Join us if you want to

  • Work in a small, high-impact team where you will be mentored to solve complex analytical problems, eventually taking ownership of your own models

  • Be resourceful to solve problems and find smarter solutions than the status quo

  • Work closely with other members of the team that will support developing your technical expertise and domain knowledge

Our team's objectives

  • The pricing team owns the loans funnel analytics and pricing strategy

  • We work across the business in a multidisciplinary capacity to identify issues, translate business problems into data questions, analyse and propose solutions

How you'll impact those objectives

  • Learn the domain of products that Lendable serves, understanding the data that informs strategy and modelling is essential to being able to successfully contribute value

  • Research and propose improvements to our existing pricing strategies and modelling methodology

  • Work closely with the credit team to align pricing decisions with credit risk and underwriting strategy

  • Clearly communicate results to stakeholders through verbal and written communication

  • Share ideas with the wider team, learn from and contribute to the body of knowledge

Key Skills

  • Experience using Python (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn) and SQL

  • Theoretical understanding of core ML techniques and statistical principles

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills, comfortable working with large datasets

  • Confident communicator and contributes effectively within a team environment

  • Self-driven and willing to take ownership of specific tasks and analyses

  • 1-2 years' experience in a technical, analytical or data-focused role

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to credit risk or financial datasets

  • Interest in Data Engineering

  • Prior experience with financial or pricing modelling

The interview process

  • A phone call with one of the team

  • Video Call case study (Remote)

  • Onsite Interview

    • Culture Interview

    • Meet the team you'll work with daily

raw.title: Talent partner
raw.description:
Talent partner

Hybrid role to be based in our Holborn, London or George Street, Edinburgh office.

About us

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

 

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

 

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

 

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

 

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role

We’re looking for a talent partner to join our talent team, reporting to our talent lead. We have an ambitious hiring plan and need an experienced talent partner who can help us bring great people into Seccl at pace.

This is a hands-on delivery role. You’ll primarily support our Product and Engineering teams, owning roles from intake and sourcing through to interview, offer and close. Product and Engineering will be your core focus, but you’ll also pick up hiring across other teams as our priorities change.

You’ll build trusted relationships with hiring managers and bring clear advice, market insight and constructive challenge. You’ll help teams make strong decisions and keep hiring moving, while recognising that hiring managers remain accountable for the final call.

Things move quickly here and plans change. You’ll need to be comfortable working with ambiguity, adapting your approach and switching focus without losing momentum. You’ll care about a high hiring bar and a brilliant candidate experience, while staying pragmatic about how we get there.

What you’ll own

  • Delivering end-to-end hiring across a portfolio of roles, primarily within product and engineering, while flexing across Seccl when priorities change to support with non-technical roles of all levels

  • Building strong candidate pipelines through direct sourcing, agency management, creative search approaches and thoughtful engagement

  • Creating pace across every hiring process, spotting blockers early and keeping candidates and hiring teams moving

  • Partnering with hiring managers and leaders to clarify what they need, share market insight and support strong, evidence-based decisions

  • Maintaining a high hiring bar and an inclusive, engaging experience without adding unnecessary process or complexity

  • Using hiring data and day-to-day insight to improve delivery, sharing practical ideas with the talent lead and wider People team

This role’s for you if...

  • You have strong experience owning and delivering end-to-end recruitment across multiple live roles in a fast moving, scaling business

  • You bring genuine expertise in product and engineering hiring, with the technical understanding and market knowledge to work credibly with hiring teams. In addition, you will have just as much passion in hiring for non-technical roles

  • You’re a confident direct sourcer who knows how to find, engage and build relationships with strong candidates

  • You’re highly delivery-focused, organised and proactive, and you naturally create momentum without needing lots of direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and incomplete information, and can change direction quickly when business priorities shift

  • You can challenge constructively, stay pragmatic and judge when to advise, when to push and when to help a hiring manager move forward

  • You’re happy to recruit outside your core specialism when needed. Experience in a fast-paced or scale-up environment would be valuable

This role isn’t for you if...

  • You’re looking for a mainly strategic or project-based role. Most of your time will be spent actively delivering hiring and owning live roles

  • You need priorities and processes to stay fixed. Our needs can change quickly, so you’ll need to adapt and make sensible calls without perfect information

  • You prefer to stay within one recruitment specialism. Product and Engineering will be your focus, but you’ll pick up roles across Seccl when needed

  • You see partnership as owning the final hiring decision. We want you to bring expertise and challenge, while enabling hiring managers to make the call and keep things moving

  • You rely mainly on inbound applications or agencies. Direct sourcing and proactive pipeline building are important parts of this role

What’s in it for you

We offer a generous mix of benefits designed around the things that matter to our people:

💰 A salary between £55,000 and £65,000, reviewed annually, plus a 6% employer pension contribution and life assurance

🌴 27 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, your birthday off and paid dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days each year

🌎 The option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate, our recognition programme offering flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

🏅 One-month paid sabbatical after eight years

🏥 Private medical insurance with AXA Health

👪 Enhanced parental leave

💻 MacBook and up to £500 towards your home office set-up

📖 £750 annual learning budget

🌻 Health and wellbeing support, including free therapy through Wellness Cloud and mental health support through Headspace

🌱 Financial wellbeing benefits, including Octopus Money, the Octopus Share Incentive Plan and will writing through Octopus Legacy

🎁 Perkbox, with flexible points and a range of discounts and perks

🚲 Access to Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture

We put people first and try hard to create an environment where people feel trusted, heard and able to do their best work.

We value openness, curiosity and different perspectives. You’ll have the freedom to challenge how things are done, experiment with better ways of working and take real ownership of your impact.

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

Interviewing is a two-way process. Our interviews are conversational, with plenty of time for you to get to know us and ask questions too.

First stage - screening interview with the talent lead

Second stage - interview with the head of people and talent lead to delve into your technical skills via a case study/scenario based task

Final stage - 45 mins bar-raiser culture-based interview with two key stakeholders for this role

We review applications as they come in and may close the role once we have enough candidates to move forward. We’ll keep you updated throughout.

Everyone’s welcome

We want to build a diverse and inclusive company full of brilliant people with different skills, experiences and perspectives. All applicants will be considered without regard to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran status, neurodiversity or disability.

If this sounds like your kind of thing, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to hear from you.

 

Compensation: £55K – £65K

Data Streaming & 2D Rendering: Experience streaming, processing, and visualizing dynamic data using 2D rendering engine tools. ML Integration: Experience building APIs and microservices that integrate directly with ML models, keeping latency and throughput constraints front-of-mind. About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.


The Role

We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Specialist to support hiring across multiple functions and regions as BJAK continues to scale globally.

This is a hands-on recruitment role for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple hiring priorities, and partnering closely with stakeholders to deliver hiring outcomes. You will have exposure to a wide range of functions including Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, and other business-critical teams.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage end-to-end recruitment processes for assigned roles across multiple functions and locations.

  • Partner closely with hiring managers to understand hiring needs, candidate profiles, and business priorities.

  • Source, screen, assess, and engage candidates through various channels including LinkedIn Recruiter, referrals, job boards, and direct outreach.

  • Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for both active and future hiring needs.

  • Conduct talent mapping and market research to support hiring strategies.

  • Coordinate and manage interview processes while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment activities within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

  • Provide regular hiring updates and pipeline insights to hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Support recruitment process improvements, hiring initiatives, and employer branding activities where required.

  • Collaborate with recruiters, coordinators, and business leaders to achieve hiring goals across the organization.


The Right Fit Has

  • 2–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or a related field.

  • Proven experience managing multiple vacancies simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, networking, and direct outreach.

  • Experience recruiting across multiple functions such as Operations, Finance, Marketing, Creative, HR, Product, Engineering, or other corporate functions.

  • Strong candidate assessment and interviewing skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and execution.

  • Comfortable operating in an environment with evolving priorities and ambitious hiring goals.

  • Demonstrates ownership, resilience, adaptability, and a proactive mindset.

  • Experience in technology companies, startups, recruitment agencies, or high-growth organizations is highly preferred.

  • Fluency in English is required. Additional language capabilities such as Mandarin, Bahasa Indonesia, Thai, or Japanese are an advantage.


What Success Looks Like

  • Delivers strong candidate pipelines across multiple functions and markets.

  • Consistently achieves hiring targets while maintaining quality and candidate experience.

  • Builds trusted relationships with hiring managers and stakeholders.

  • Demonstrates strong ownership and accountability throughout the recruitment process.

  • Contributes to improving recruitment efficiency, hiring quality, and overall team performance.


Why Join BJAK

  • Above-market remuneration.

  • Fast-track career growth and development opportunities.

  • Exposure to international hiring across multiple markets and functions.

  • Opportunity to work directly with experienced recruiters and business leaders.

  • High ownership, autonomy, and responsibility from day one.

  • Flat organization where ideas and execution matter more than titles.

  • Meaningful work that directly contributes to the growth and success of the business.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

description: About OLIX AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. Reporting to the Chief Legal Officer, you will own commercial contracting end to end as OLIX moves from a small legal team to a function that supports a rapidly scaling business. You will be the lead lawyer on some of our most important projects and largest and most complex deals, the person the business comes to to help them make clear and quick risk decisions and, as the company grows, you will have the opportunity to recruit team members. You will define the playbooks, standards, and tooling that let OLIX scale faster than legal headcount. This is a player-coach role for a technically excellent, experienced lawyer who wants to own a function in an environment accelerating and changing quickly, work hands-on with engineers and commercial leaders, and shape how commercial legal works at one of the most ambitious deep-tech companies in Europe. You will not be sitting above the work. You will be leading the toughest negotiations yourself, making judgement calls where the law, the facts, and the commercial picture are all still moving, and building the team that handles everything else. OLIX moves quickly, priorities shift, and there is often no precedent to lean on. You need to have worked in an environment like this before, or be able to show you would thrive in one. Open to UK-based candidates and US-qualified attorneys willing to relocate to London. We provide full visa sponsorship and relocation support. Responsibilities Lead the commercial legal function end to end: strategy, team, deal flow, tooling, and standards. Personally lead negotiations on OLIX’s largest and most complex commercial deals, including customer agreements with hyperscalers, manufacturing, and other supply chain agreements with contract manufacturing partners, NREs, JDAs, technology licences, and strategic partnerships. Build and scale the commercial legal team as OLIX grows. You will be hands-on as the main lawyer on your own projects from day one and, in time, hire, develop, and line-manage additional team members. Set commercial legal standards, playbooks, fallback positions, and templates across the function. Working with the CLO, make risk decisions, and help the business make them. Cut through ambiguity, frame legal and commercial risk in plain terms, recommend a position, and own the call, including where the facts, the law, or the commercial context are developing and moving quickly. Design and build scalable legal workflows using AI tooling and automation, so the legal function scales faster than headcount. Integrate AI deeply into day-to-day contracting: triage, first-pass review, redline generation, clause extraction, precedent search, and playbook enforcement. Set OLIX’s positions on key commercial terms including liability caps, indemnities, IP ownership and licensing, data protection, warranties, termination, and service levels. Own the IP dimension of commercial work: structure and negotiate IP ownership, background and foreground IP, licensing, confidentiality, and know-how provisions in JDAs, NREs, and manufacturing and supply arrangements, working closely with engineering and IP counsel to protect OLIX’s core technology, working closely with the CLO and other senior leaders to define and implement IP strategy. Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, Operations, and Engineering to align legal with business strategy. Manage external counsel for specialist workstreams including US contracting, specialist IP, data, and export controls. Partner with the CLO and other team members on cross-functional matters including corporate, governance, and regulatory work that touches commercial contracting. Contribute to legal tooling selection, CLM implementation, and internal enablement across the broader legal team. Skills & Experience Qualified solicitor in England and Wales, or US-qualified attorney (admitted to a US state bar), guidance being at least 8 to 12 years of post-qualification experience. Trained at a top-tier City, US, or comparable international firm. Technically excellent lawyer. Rigorous legal analysis, precise drafting, and a structured approach to playbooks and standard forms. You know when precision matters and when speed does, and you are the person more junior lawyers check their work with. Demonstrable track record leading complex commercial contract negotiations end to end as the responsible lawyer, not just supporting a partner, and of being the main lawyer on multi-workstream projects (a manufacturing ramp, a major customer deployment, a strategic partnership) rather than on a single contract. Technical IP experience. You have negotiated IP ownership, background and foreground IP, licensing, confidentiality, and know-how provisions in technology development, manufacturing, and supply arrangements (JDAs, NREs, foundry and supply agreements), ideally involving semiconductors, hardware, or other deep technology. You do not need to be a patent attorney, but you need to understand what is being created and licensed and how to protect it. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making risk decisions. You can take an incomplete picture, work out what matters, give a clear recommendation, and own it. You help the business make good risk calls rather than handing it a list of issues. Proper, relevant experience of an environment like OLIX: you have built, scaled, or meaningfully contributed to a commercial legal function in a fast-moving technology or hardware business, ideally a venture-backed scale-up, working directly with founders, engineers, and commercial teams. Line-management or mentoring experience with junior counsel, paralegals, or secondees. Does not need to be extensive but needs to be real, and you want to manage and grow a team as the function scales. Comfortable with technical subject matter. You can get to grips with OLIX’s technology well enough to draft and negotiate around it credibly and to hold your own with engineers. AI-native approach to legal work. You actively use AI tools in your day-to-day practice, have strong instincts for what AI does well and where it fails, and treat AI fluency as a core craft skill rather than a novelty. Bias toward building scalable systems over doing work manually. You look for the automation, template, or workflow that solves the problem ten times, not just once. Commercially pragmatic, able to move at pace, and comfortable owning positions without constant supervision. Direct, plain-language communicator. The right fit for how OLIX works: hands-on, direct, high ownership, and comfortable being part of the team rather than a gatekeeper. You would rather solve the problem than write the memo. Nice to have Experience in technology or in technical manufacturing more broadly, ideally B2B hardware, semiconductors, or infrastructure. Highly desirable. Supply chain experience: supply, manufacturing, component, and logistics arrangements, and the issues that come with scaling a hardware supply chain (capacity and volume commitments, allocation, lead times, quality, tooling, dual-sourcing). Highly desirable. Familiarity with enterprise or cloud customer contracting, including bespoke negotiations with hyperscalers. Understanding of export controls (particularly the US and UK regimes for advanced computing and semiconductors) and data protection as they arise in commercial contracts. Experience implementing or selecting CLM or legal AI tooling (Ironclad, Harvey, Legora, Spellbook, Robin, Eve, etc.). Light coding or low-code fluency (Python, SQL, Zapier, n8n, or similar) for building internal workflows. Compensation & Equity Competitive Salary: Commensurate with your experience, skills, and location Equity & Ownership: Meaningful stock options. You’re not just joining the mission; you’re owning a piece of it Proximity Bonus: We value your time. To minimise your commute and maximise your life, we offer an annual Living-Local Bonus if your residence is within 20 minutes of the office Retirement Benefits: Employer-contributed retirement plans to help you build long-term financial security. Due to U.S. export control regulations, candidates’ eligibility to work at OLIX depends on their most recent citizenship or permanent residency status. This role exists to protect that foundation. You’ll take ownership of the health, performance and security of customer environments across Microsoft Azure and on-premises infrastructure. You’ll prevent avoidable issues, resolve complex problems and ensure new solutions move smoothly into live service. Working across Service Desk, Cyber Security and project delivery, you’ll help turn infrastructure support from a reactive service into a proactive source of customer confidence and long-term value What you'll be doing: Infrastructure health and performance Own the day-to-day health of customer infrastructure across Azure and on-premises environments. Monitor availability, performance and capacity, taking action before emerging issues affect the customer. Secure and controlled operations Maintain secure configurations, access controls and patching standards across supported platforms. Ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within agreed timescales and that operational activity supports Cyber Essentials and ISO 27001 expectations. Incident resolution and prevention Act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents. Diagnose issues across servers, storage, virtualisation, networking and cloud services, then turn root-cause findings into preventative improvements. Platform maintenance and recovery Plan and deliver patches, upgrades and maintenance activity with the right change control, testing and rollback planning. Maintain backup, restore and disaster-recovery readiness across customer environments. Customer and service improvement Identify practical ways to make customer environments more stable, secure and efficient. Provide clear recommendations that improve service quality and create opportunities for wider optimisation or modernisation. Cross-team delivery Work closely with Service Desk, Cyber Security and project teams to ensure infrastructure changes are supportable from day one. Create useful runbooks, accurate records and effective knowledge transfer rather than documentation for its own sake. The kind of problems you’ll solve A customer’s infrastructure is slowing down, but the cause could sit across compute, storage, networking or cloud services. An Azure or Windows Server environment has grown without enough control, creating performance, cost or security risks. Critical patches must be deployed without disrupting customer operations. Backup jobs appear successful, but recovery readiness has not been properly validated. An Azure Virtual Desktop environment is creating inconsistent performance or user disruption. Storage capacity is approaching its limit, with no clear plan for optimisation or expansion. A recurring incident has been repeatedly fixed but never properly prevented. Tu participeras à toutes les étapes des projets : de la définition du brief jusqu'à l'analyse des résultats, avec un réel niveau de responsabilité.</p> <p>En tant qu'alternant·e Influence Campaign Manager, tu rejoindras notre équipe Customer Marketing pour contribuer au développement des campagnes d'influence de Picnic en France. Tu travailleras au quotidien avec notre agence partenaire ainsi qu'avec nos équipes internationales afin de donner vie à des campagnes créatives à fort impact.</p> <p>Le poste de stagiaire est à pourvoir à partir de janvier 2027.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Tes missions</strong></h2> <p>Rattaché·e au Brand &amp; Media Manager France, tu coordonneras le déploiement des campagnes d’influence sur le marché français, en lien direct avec notre agence partenaire.</p> <p>Tu seras notamment amené·e à :</p> <ul> <li>Participer à la définition des briefs créatifs des campagnes avec notre équipe internationale et notre agence</li> <li>Sélectionner et challenger les profils d'influenceur·euse·s proposés par l'agence en évaluant leur pertinence, leur audience et leur adéquation avec la marque Picnic</li> <li data-section-id="1wzjo1k" data-start="2878" data-end="2969">Coordonner le suivi des campagnes, de la production des contenus jusqu'à leur publication</li> <li data-section-id="1v3xz7q" data-start="2970" data-end="3078">Analyser les performances des campagnes, contribuer aux reportings et identifier des pistes d'optimisation</li> <li data-section-id="1v3xz7q" data-start="2970" data-end="3078">Réaliser une veille continue sur les tendances des réseaux sociaux, les créateurs de contenu et les activations de la concurrence</li> </ul> <h2><strong>À propos de toi</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Tu suis une formation dans un domaine lié à la communication, la publicité et/ou le marketing, idéalement avec une&nbsp;première expérience en gestion de projet</li> <li>Tu es autonome, organisé·e et attentif·ve aux détails</li> <li>Tu as envie d’apprendre dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution</li> <li>Tu as une bonne connaissance des réseaux sociaux et de l’univers de l’influence</li> <li>Tu maîtrises le français et l’anglais</li> <li>Tu es à l'aise avec Excel et avec les KPI d'une campagne d'influence</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Avantages Picnic</strong></h2> <p>🍴 Restauration</p> <p>Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements.</p> <p>🚲 Santé et transports</p> <p>Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, si tu te rends au travail en transports en commun, nous te remboursons ton abonnement à hauteur de 50%.</p> <p>✍️ Développement personnel et professionnel</p> <p>Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à un environnement dynamique, jeune et international.</p> <p>🎫Sorties et divertissement</p> <p>Profite d'un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu profiteras aussi d'invitations à tous nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party !</p> <p>💰Gratification</p> <p>Pour ce stage de 6 mois, nous offrons un salaire brut de 1500,00 € par mois.&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong><em>Merci de soumettre ta candidature en anglais et de préparer un CV en anglais.</em></strong></h3> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Manager I, Engineering - Language Platform
description: <p><a href="https://docs.datadoghq.com/tracing/">Application Performance Monitoring</a> (APM) is one of Datadog’s premier products that helps developers see inside complex distributed systems. Our SDKs are both the delivery vehicle for APM and the platform on which all of Datadog’s service and app based products (e.g. Application Security Management, Profiling, Data Stream Monitoring…) are delivered. We believe our SDKs are one of our technical moats and are a key competitive advantage for APM and Datadog more broadly. They’re also open-source.</p> <p>Leading the evolution of our SDKs is a technically demanding and highly collaborative effort. You’ll work with language experts to deliver cutting-edge observability products across our 9 supported languages, with industry leading performance and a world class developer experience. You’ll rethink our SDKs’ architecture, APIs, data models, and protocol to meet Datadog’s current needs and scale, all while building in the open. And you’ll grow your team’s capacity by fostering a culture focused on customer needs, continuous learning, and innovation.&nbsp;</p> <p>We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager who cares as much about technical excellence as empowering other engineering teams.&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships that it builds, the creativity it brings to the table, and the collaboration of being together. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our employees can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.</em></p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, grow, and develop a team of roughly 4-8 library engineers — coaching, giving direct feedback, and empowering senior ICs as technical leaders owning outcomes</li> <li>Own team delivery and productivity: planning, milestones, reviews</li> <li>Collaborate with Product teams to:</li> <ul> <li>Reshape and grow our platform capabilities to enable product teams&nbsp;</li> <li>Define and deliver industry leading, open-source, zero-touch APM instrumentation</li> </ul> <li>Stay technically close to the work — apply strong technical judgment, set a high standard for quality, contribute code where it matters most, and keep quality and architecture high</li> <li>Build strong relationships and drive alignment across the language teams and product, backend</li> <li>Shape team identity and culture</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <ul> <li>An experienced Engineering Manager with a track record of shipping&nbsp;</li> <li>A strong and empathetic leader with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams to deliver high quality software</li> <li>An ability pivot from high level product narratives to highly technical implementation details&nbsp;</li> <li>You have significant programming experience in one or more of: Go, C, Rust</li> <li><strong><em>Bonus</em></strong><strong>:</strong> If you possess experience with one or more of these skills: systems programming experience, observability tooling experience, experience shipping client side software, Go runtime expertise</li> </ul> <p><em>Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits and Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)</li> <li>Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing</li> <li>Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking</li> <li>An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)</li> <li>Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions</li> <li>Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+</li> <li>Competitive global benefits</li> </ul> <p><br><em>Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.</em></p> <p style="color: white;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>About Datadog:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée&nbsp; en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit&nbsp; de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.</p> <p><strong>Pré-requis</strong></p> <p>Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :<br>BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur<br>Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études<br>Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027<br>Durée : 4 à 6 mois</p> <p><strong>Références</strong></p> <ol> <li>Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., &amp; Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. <em>Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision</em>, <em>64</em>(6), 672-689.</li> <li>Buolamwini, J., &amp; Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In <em>Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency</em> (pp. 77-91). PMLR.</li> <li>Cho, J., Zala, A., &amp; Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.</li> <li>Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., &amp; Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. <em>CoRR abs/2308.02935</em>.</li> <li>Thong, W., Joniak, P., &amp; Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.</li> <li>Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., &amp; Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In <em>ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings</em> (pp. 5344-5351).</li> <li>Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., &amp; El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In <em>International conference on machine learning</em>(pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.</li> <li>Giuliani, L., Misino, E., &amp; Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In <em>International Conference on Machine Learning</em> (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.</li> </ol> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Technicien Maintenance & Métrologie
description: A propos du poste : Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences. Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein d’un environnement industriel pharmaceutique et dermo-cosmétique , nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Métrologie & Conformité. Intégré(e) au service Utilités & Métrologie , vous contribuez au suivi et à la fiabilité du parc d’appareillage scientifique du site. Votre rôle est de garantir la conformité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des équipements , tout en assurant le suivi des interventions de métrologie et de maintenance. Missions Principales : Assurer la gestion, le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d’équipements et d’appareils de mesure ; Planifier et réaliser les contrôles et vérifications métrologiques périodiques des équipements ; Participer au suivi et à la vérification des installations liées au traitement d’air, CVC et HVAC ; Réaliser ou coordonner les opérations de maintenance et de métrologie, en collaboration avec les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes ; Analyser les pannes, dysfonctionnements et non-conformités, assurer leur suivi et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des actions correctives ; Analyser les rapports de contrôle et vérifier la conformité des prestations réalisées ; Réaliser des essais techniques et comparatifs afin de développer ou d’améliorer les méthodes de contrôle métrologique ; Rédiger, mettre à jour et déployer les procédures métrologiques et organisationnelles ; Assurer la traçabilité des interventions ainsi que la mise à jour des informations relatives aux équipements dans les outils de gestion dédiés ; Collaborer avec les différents services afin d’analyser les prestations réalisées, d’identifier les nouveaux besoins et de garantir le maintien en conformité du parc Requirements À propos de vous Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. Expérience : Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience sur des activités de métrologie, maintenance, instrumentation ou suivi d’équipements, idéalement dans un environnement industriel réglementé. Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez les activités de métrologie et de vérification périodique, ainsi que le suivi d’un parc d’équipements. Des connaissances en traitement d’air / CVC / HVAC, maintenance et analyse de pannes sont appréciées. Qualité et conformité : Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’identification et le traitement des non-conformités, l’analyse de rapports de contrôle et la gestion documentaire associée. Outils : Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel. La connaissance d’un logiciel de gestion de la métrologie, notamment Optimu, constitue un plus. Référentiels : La connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et ISO 10012, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires liées à la métrologie, est appréciée. Formation : Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation technique Bac+2 à Bac+3 en métrologie, mesures physiques, instrumentation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine équivalent. Qualités personnelles : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre sens de l’organisation. Votre esprit d’analyse, vos qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles et votre capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette mission. Permis B requis. Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur . Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient. Exceller avec bienveillance Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune. Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya. raw.title: Technicien Maintenance & Métrologie
raw.description:
A propos du poste :

Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences.

Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein d’un environnement industriel pharmaceutique et dermo-cosmétique, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Métrologie & Conformité.

Intégré(e) au service Utilités & Métrologie, vous contribuez au suivi et à la fiabilité du parc d’appareillage scientifique du site. Votre rôle est de garantir la conformité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des équipements, tout en assurant le suivi des interventions de métrologie et de maintenance.

Missions Principales :

  • Assurer la gestion, le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d’équipements et d’appareils de mesure ;
  • Planifier et réaliser les contrôles et vérifications métrologiques périodiques des équipements ;
  • Participer au suivi et à la vérification des installations liées au traitement d’air, CVC et HVAC ;
  • Réaliser ou coordonner les opérations de maintenance et de métrologie, en collaboration avec les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes ;
  • Analyser les pannes, dysfonctionnements et non-conformités, assurer leur suivi et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des actions correctives ;
  • Analyser les rapports de contrôle et vérifier la conformité des prestations réalisées ;
  • Réaliser des essais techniques et comparatifs afin de développer ou d’améliorer les méthodes de contrôle métrologique ;
  • Rédiger, mettre à jour et déployer les procédures métrologiques et organisationnelles ;
  • Assurer la traçabilité des interventions ainsi que la mise à jour des informations relatives aux équipements dans les outils de gestion dédiés ;
  • Collaborer avec les différents services afin d’analyser les prestations réalisées, d’identifier les nouveaux besoins et de garantir le maintien en conformité du parc

Requirements

À propos de vous

Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant.

  • Expérience : Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience sur des activités de métrologie, maintenance, instrumentation ou suivi d’équipements, idéalement dans un environnement industriel réglementé.
  • Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez les activités de métrologie et de vérification périodique, ainsi que le suivi d’un parc d’équipements. Des connaissances en traitement d’air / CVC / HVAC, maintenance et analyse de pannes sont appréciées.
  • Qualité et conformité : Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’identification et le traitement des non-conformités, l’analyse de rapports de contrôle et la gestion documentaire associée.
  • Outils : Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel. La connaissance d’un logiciel de gestion de la métrologie, notamment Optimu, constitue un plus.
  • Référentiels : La connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et ISO 10012, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires liées à la métrologie, est appréciée.
  • Formation : Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation technique Bac+2 à Bac+3 en métrologie, mesures physiques, instrumentation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine équivalent.
  • Qualités personnelles : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre sens de l’organisation. Votre esprit d’analyse, vos qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles et votre capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette mission.
  • Permis B requis.

Benefits

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé.

Ce qui nous distingue :

Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur.

Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient.

Exceller avec bienveillance

Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune.

Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya.

Rejoignez-nous aujourd’hui et devenez un Excelyate !

boissons.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.</p> </li> <li> <p>Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.</p> </li> <li> <p>Des résultats démontrables en matière d’acquisition de nouveaux Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d’activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s’appliquer.</p> <p>Les conditions d’éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s’entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.</p> <h2>Formation et accompagnement</h2> <p>Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l’accompagnement des clients.</p> <p>Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.</p> <p>Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d’analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d’organisation.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Job Application Tip</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don’t tick every box, it’s ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

L'offre de paris sportifs chez Winamax repose sur le traitement en temps réel de flux massifs de données et l'ajustement continu de probabilités. Pour garantir la cohérence entre les cotes et l'exposition financière de Winamax, l'analyse automatisée des mouvements de marché, du volume des mises et des activités atypiques est devenue un enjeu stratégique.
 
La question à laquelle doit répondre le stage : 
Comment détecter algorithmiquement les incohérences de probabilités et les volumes atypiques en temps réel pour fournir un Indice de Confiance fiable, capable d'assister la prise de décision ?

Objectifs du stage
  • Modéliser la cohérence des cotes et un Indice de Confiance : Concevoir des modèles statistiques pour repérer les décalages de probabilités et évaluer en temps réel la fiabilité des activités à fort volume, en croisant la notoriété de l'événement et son historique
  • Intégrer le module au cœur de l'outil trading existant : Développer une brique algorithmique performante qui s'interface directement avec l'application métier des traders, afin d'enrichir leurs outils
  • Validation & mesure de performance (Backtesting) : Tester et calibrer les modèles sur des historiques massifs de données pour maximiser leur précision, minimiser les fausses alertes et mesurer l'impact réel de l'outil sur l'activité

  • Précision du ciblage (taux de faux positifs) : nécessité d'ajuster finement les seuils statistiques pour remonter des signaux réellement pertinents sans engorger l'outil d'alertes inutiles

description: About AQEMIA AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs.  At the core of our mission is  QEMI , our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.   What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing  never-before-seen molecules , without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.   Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently  in vivo optimization , targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.   For more information, visit  AQEMIA.com,  our  WTTJ Page , and our  LinkedIn .    About our Team AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.   This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.   About our Engineering Department The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.   Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.   Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience. The role As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end — from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners. A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well — establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources — so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it. As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation — expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them. Responsibilities Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow. Model canonical scientific entities — compounds, structures, assays, predictions — establishing identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous and often messy sources. Set and uphold data quality standards through monitoring, validation, testing and alerting across critical pipelines, strengthening governance and observability so datasets stay trusted and accessible. Partner with ML engineers, data scientists and researchers to build curated, model-ready datasets, translating scientific and business requirements into scalable data solutions. Drive data architecture and engineering best practices — data modeling, testing, documentation, orchestration and deployment — in collaboration with the Engineering Manager and Staff Data Engineer on roadmap execution. Build self-service capabilities and, looking ahead, APIs that make data fit for automation as AQEMIA moves toward more service-based integration. Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, and mentor junior engineers by sharing knowledge and best practices as a senior individual contributor. Qualifications Deep experience in data engineering, with a track record of production systems that other teams depend on. We care about what you have built, not the year count.  Strong software engineering skills. You code, you review code, and you hold a quality bar. Expert in Python and SQL. - Strong data modelling and relational database experience. You can defend an identity key. Production experience with a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a transformation framework (we use dbt). Experience with workflow orchestration (we use Airflow) and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform on AWS). Any STEM degree or equivalent experience. Nice-to-have Experience with AWS. Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and modern data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and object storage. Experience in drug discovery, biotech, pharma or deeptech environments. Exposure to AI-driven or data-intensive workflows, or experience working across disciplines (e.g. biology ↔ ML ↔ chemistry). Experience implementing data governance, lineage and metadata management solutions. Track record of improving platform scalability, reliability and operational maturity. Expanding Drug Discovery Pipeline  : Focused on critical therapeutic areas like Oncology, CNS, Immuno-inflammation... with in vivo proof of concept/patent stage programs. Collaborations with top Pharma, including a $140M Sanofi deal. World-Class Interdisciplinary Team  : work alongside exceptional talent at the intersection of technology and life sciences. Our teams combine deep expertise in AI, physics-based modeling, biology, and medicinal chemistry to push the boundaries of innovation. DeepTech Recognition : AQEMIA is proud to be part of the  French Tech 40  and  France 2030 , highlighting our role as a key player in Europe’s DeepTech ecosystem. Prime Location with Flexibility  : Our offices are located in the heart of  Paris  and  London (King’s Cross) , with flexible work arrangements including up to two remote days per week. This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.
 

About our Engineering Department

The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.
 
Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.
 
Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience.

The role

As our Senior Data Engineer, you'll own AQEMIA's data platform end to end — from ingestion through the pipeline to the trusted, model-ready datasets that power science, ML and analytics. What makes this role distinctive is the data itself: chemical structures, molecular conformations, physics- and ML-based predictions, and experimental results from CROs and partners.

A core part of the work is modelling these scientific entities well — establishing canonical identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous, often messy sources — so scientists, and increasingly AI agents, can rely on them. You'll work at the intersection of software engineering, data infrastructure and scientific research, with real scope to shape architecture rather than just execute against it.

As AQEMIA moves toward more service and API-driven integration next year, you'll help make data fit for automation — expanding your impact from pipelines to the systems that consume them.


Responsibilities
  • Own AQEMIA's Bronze → Silver → Gold data pipelines end to end, from ingestion through transformation and delivery, maintaining lineage and traceability as data volume and complexity grow.
  • Model canonical scientific entities — compounds, structures, assays, predictions — establishing identity, provenance and trustworthy lineage across heterogeneous and often messy sources.
  • Set and uphold data quality standards through monitoring, validation, testing and alerting across critical pipelines, strengthening governance and observability so datasets stay trusted and accessible.
  • Partner with ML engineers, data scientists and researchers to build curated, model-ready datasets, translating scientific and business requirements into scalable data solutions.
  • Drive data architecture and engineering best practices — data modeling, testing, documentation, orchestration and deployment — in collaboration with the Engineering Manager and Staff Data Engineer on roadmap execution.
  • Build self-service capabilities and, looking ahead, APIs that make data fit for automation as AQEMIA moves toward more service-based integration.
  • Uphold engineering quality through code reviews, and mentor junior engineers by sharing knowledge and best practices as a senior individual contributor.

    • Qualifications
  • Deep experience in data engineering, with a track record of production systems that other teams depend on. We care about what you have built, not the year count. 
  • Strong software engineering skills. You code, you review code, and you hold a quality bar.
  • Expert in Python and SQL. - Strong data modelling and relational database experience. You can defend an identity key.
  • Production experience with a cloud warehouse (we use Snowflake) and a transformation framework (we use dbt).
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (we use Airflow) and infrastructure-as-code (we use Terraform on AWS).
  • Any STEM degree or equivalent experience.

    • Nice-to-have
  • Experience with AWS.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and modern data warehousing (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) and object storage.
  • Experience in drug discovery, biotech, pharma or deeptech environments.
  • Exposure to AI-driven or data-intensive workflows, or experience working across disciplines (e.g. biology ↔ ML ↔ chemistry).
  • Experience implementing data governance, lineage and metadata management solutions.
  • Track record of improving platform scalability, reliability and operational maturity.

    1. First discussion with our Talent Acquisition
    2. Hiring Manager’s interview: you’ll meet directly with your future manager
    3. Technical assessment of your skills in a deep-dive interview with the team

    5. Cultural fit interview with our co-founder and COO, Emmanuelle
    6. Final interview with our co-founder and CEO, Maximillien

    At AQEMIA, we work for a mission: joining us means having your own impact on changing the way drugs are discovered, and helping to shape the direction of our fast-growing company and team.
    Expanding Drug Discovery Pipeline : Focused on critical therapeutic areas like Oncology, CNS, Immuno-inflammation... with in vivo proof of concept/patent stage programs. Collaborations with top Pharma, including a $140M Sanofi deal.
    World-Class Interdisciplinary Team : work alongside exceptional talent at the intersection of technology and life sciences. Our teams combine deep expertise in AI, physics-based modeling, biology, and medicinal chemistry to push the boundaries of innovation.

    Prime Location with Flexibility : Our offices are located in the heart of Paris and London (King’s Cross), with flexible work arrangements including up to two remote days per week.

About AQEMIA

AQEMIA is a drug invention company dedicated to creating entirely new medicines to address major unmet medical needs. At the core of our mission is QEMI, our proprietary molecule-invention platform, which uniquely combines cutting-edge science with advanced technology. Powered by physics-based modeling, statistical mechanics, and generative AI, QEMI allows our teams to design novel drug candidates from first principles.
 
What makes AQEMIA different is our commitment to true innovation: our research is dedicated to the invention of new molecular entities, not the refinement of existing ones. We focus on inventing never-before-seen molecules, without relying on experimental data, and advancing them into a growing pipeline of proprietary programs and strategic partnerships with leading pharmaceutical companies.
 
Our most advanced preclinical programs are currently in vivo optimization, targeting diseases still waiting for effective treatments, offering our teams the opportunity to work on science that can make a real difference in people’s lives.
 
For more information, visit AQEMIA.com, our WTTJ Page, and our LinkedIn. 
 

About our Team

AQEMIA brings together a diverse, multidisciplinary team of 80+ professionals based in Paris and London. Our scientists and engineers, including chemists, physicists, machine learning experts, and software engineers, work side by side to push the boundaries of early-stage drug discovery.
 
This close collaboration across disciplines is central to our approach, enabling us to tackle complex scientific challenges from first principles and translate cutting-edge ideas into novel therapeutic candidates. At AQEMIA, team members are encouraged to contribute their expertise, learn from one another, and play an active role in shaping the future of drug invention.
 

About our Engineering Department

The Engineering team (~12 people) builds and scales the technical foundations that power Aqemia’s drug discovery engine.
 
Bringing together expertise across software engineering, cloud infrastructure, data engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), and scientific computing, the team designs and operates robust, secure, and high-performance platforms that enable Aqemia’s scientific and AI teams to experiment, train, deploy, and run models at scale.
 
Their work spans data infrastructure, scientific compute systems, cloud operations, orchestration, observability, CI/CD, developer tooling, and platform scalability. By transforming cutting-edge research into reliable and scalable systems, the team accelerates the discovery of new medicines while ensuring operational excellence and an outstanding developer experience.

As Engineering Manager of the Compute team, you will lead a team of 5 engineers responsible for building and evolving the compute platform that powers AQEMIA's scientific simulations, machine learning workloads, and large-scale experimentation. You will combine strong engineering leadership with technical credibility to grow a high-performing team while delivering reliable and scalable platform capabilities.

Responsibilities

Lead and grow the Compute Engineering team

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of Software Engineers through regular feedback, career development and mentoring.

  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture built on ownership, trust and continuous improvement.

  • Recruit, onboard and retain exceptional engineering talent.

  • Help engineers grow both technically and professionally while creating clear development paths.

    • Deliver Compute roadmap

  • Partner with Product, Staff Engineers and Engineering Leadership to define priorities and execute the Compute roadmap.

  • Drive predictable delivery by supporting scientific computing, AI workloads and internal developer platforms.

  • Balance new capabilities, operational excellence and technical debt reduction.

  • Identify and proactively manage delivery risks, dependencies and execution challenges.

    • Ensure operational excellence

  • Drive high engineering standards across architecture, testing, observability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Improve the scalability, resilience and performance of production systems supporting research and platform teams.

  • Promote modern engineering practices including automation, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code and AI-assisted software development.

  • Continuously improve engineering processes, team effectiveness and operational maturity.

    • Partner across Engineering and Science

  • Collaborate closely with Platform, Data, AI and Scientific teams to translate research needs into scalable engineering solutions.

  • Facilitate communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ensure engineering execution remains aligned with AQEMIA's scientific objectives and business priorities.

  • Support cross-functional planning, architecture discussions and technical decision-making.

    • Contribute to Engineering leadership

  • Partner with Engineering Leadership on organizational planning, hiring strategy and team evolution.

  • Help define engineering standards, operating principles and best practices across the organization.

  • Contribute to long-term platform strategy and engineering scalability.

  • Foster knowledge sharing, technical excellence and continuous learning across teams.


    • Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering, including experience building production systems at scale.

  • Previous experience leading engineering teams as an Engineering Manager or Tech Lead with people management responsibilities.

  • Strong experience delivering distributed systems, cloud-native applications or compute-intensive platforms.

  • Solid software engineering background with hands-on experience in Python and modern backend development.

  • Experience working with AWS, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Snowflake and modern cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, observability and operational excellence.

  • Experience leading roadmap execution and coordinating cross-functional engineering initiatives.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence across engineering, scientific and business stakeholders.

  • Strong coaching mindset with a passion for developing engineers and building high-performing teams.

  • Pragmatic approach to balancing delivery, technical excellence and organizational priorities.


    • Nice-to-have

  • Experience leading Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, Compute or SRE teams.

  • Exposure to scientific computing, machine learning infrastructure or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with large-scale compute environments, GPU infrastructure or distributed training systems.

  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems and developer platforms.

  • Experience implementing AI-assisted engineering workflows and spec-driven development practices.

  • Track record of scaling engineering organizations in fast-growing technology companies.

  • Interest in computational chemistry, life sciences or scientific research environments.


    • Our Recruitment Process

    2. Role Alignment & Leadership Interview with Hiring Manager (45 min) 

    3. Technical Assessment with a member of Engineering team (60 min)

    6. Final interview with Maximilien, Co-founder and CEO (60 min)

    At AQEMIA, we work for a mission: joining us means having your own impact on changing the way drugs are discovered, and helping to shape the direction of our fast-growing company and team.
